items.title: 美國8月CPI成9月升息關鍵！美銀、花旗預演兩種相反劇本
paras: 美國8月消費者物價指數（CPI）即將於下週五（11日）公布，這份通膨報告可能成為聯準會（Fed）9月利率決策的重要依據。華爾街主要機構目前看法分歧，美銀證券預期通膨數據仍具韌性，可能為本月升息提供支持；花旗則認為核心通膨將持續降溫，聯準會更可能選擇按兵不動。
美銀證券預估8月核心CPI月增0.22%，對應核心個人消費支出物價指數（核心PCE）月增約0.24%，年增率則升至3.4%。
美銀認為，若數據符合預期，通膨仍未充分受到控制，足以讓聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）傾向支持再次升息，因此8月CPI可望成為9月升息與否的關鍵考驗。
相較之下，花旗預估8月核心CPI僅月增0.184%，年增率降至2.3%。若預測成真，將創下2021年4月核心CPI突破2%以來最低年增率，可能讓多數聯準會官員認為通膨已趨於溫和，進而選擇維持目前利率不變。
不過，部分分析人士警告，如果8月CPI意外高於預期，加上超核心PCE通膨目前已升至3.9%，以及強勁的8月就業數據，聯準會可能被迫採取更激進的緊縮政策，甚至將利率推升至5%以上並主動倒置殖利率曲線，屆時美股可能面臨明顯下行壓力。

沃勒成關鍵搖擺票　核心PCE成升息門檻

聯準會9月會議是否升息，除了取決於即將公布的通膨數據，也牽涉到官員之間的票數角力。在鷹派與鴿派立場接近的情況下，理事沃勒（Christopher Waller）被視為可能左右結果的關鍵票。
沃勒先前接受《路透》訪問時表示，如果通膨持續朝2%目標改善，他願意支持維持目前政策利率不變，並指出8月通膨數據將是其做出決策的重要依據。
美銀證券指出，華許在傑克遜霍爾年會的談話釋出明顯鷹派訊號，似乎已降低再次升息的門檻；相較之下，紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯（John Williams）與沃勒的立場則相對偏向鴿派。
美銀分析認為，沃勒可能以核心PCE月增率0.30%作為重要門檻，若高於此水準，才可能支持升息。
美銀預估核心PCE月增約0.24%，低於該門檻，但若華許支持升息，且實際數據大致符合預期，聯準會內部仍可能形成足夠多數，支持再次升息。
花旗則認為，在沃勒本周發表相關談話後，市場對何謂「過熱」通膨的容忍度已有所提高。換言之，只要數據經四捨五入後仍呈現0.2%的月增幅，對多數聯準會官員而言可能仍屬溫和，足以支持暫停升息。

CPI、PCE背離　住房與醫療成本成關鍵

市場預測之所以出現明顯分歧，也與CPI及PCE兩項通膨指標的結構差異有關。目前兩者反映出的通膨走勢並不一致。
分析指出，住房支出在CPI權重約占三分之一，但在PCE中的占比明顯較低。過去一年住房通膨持續降溫，是核心CPI下滑的重要推力，也成為CPI與PCE走勢差距擴大的主要原因。
另一方面，PCE對醫療保健支出的涵蓋程度較高，除了消費者支出，也包括Medicare、Medicaid及雇主負擔的醫療支出；CPI則主要衡量消費者自行支付的部分。因此，醫療成本上升正對核心PCE形成較大推升效果，尤其反映在超核心PCE。
克里夫蘭聯準銀行的通膨即時預測模型顯示，核心CPI預計在9月進一步降至2.3%，接近聯準會2%的通膨目標；核心PCE則預計同期升至約3.5%，兩項指標呈現明顯背離。
華許日前在傑克遜霍爾演說中也確認，PCE通膨是聯準會首要的政策參考指標，其中尤其關注超核心PCE，也就是扣除能源與住房後的PCE服務通膨。
目前超核心PCE已升至3.9%，且仍呈上升趨勢，反映工資所帶動的服務通膨壓力仍然存在。

就業、能源價格反彈　鷹派再添兩項支撐

在通膨數據公布前，8月就業報告已率先為聯準會鷹派陣營提供支撐。
美國8月非農就業新增16.2萬人，明顯高於市場預期的5.5萬人，年化薪資增幅達3.1%。由於這份就業數據是在沃勒發表上述談話後才公布，聯準會在評估薪資與通膨之間的關聯時，可能需要重新衡量相關數據。
能源價格同樣可能推升整體通膨。美銀證券與花旗均預期，8月能源價格在連續數月下跌後反彈，帶動整體CPI月增率升至約0.34%至0.37%，年增率也可能從7月約3.4%的水準進一步走高。
分析指出，中東局勢持續緊張，荷姆茲海峽尚未恢復正常通行，加上全球石油庫存持續下降，能源價格若大幅上漲，除了直接推升整體通膨，也可能透過薪資與物價的相互影響，進一步傳導至核心通膨，增加聯準會緊縮政策的壓力。

升息預期若升溫　高估值美股恐面臨壓力

對金融市場而言，8月CPI的影響同樣不容小覷。
目前標普500指數席勒本益比已超過42倍，處於泡沫估值區間。分析認為，如果聯準會因通膨重新升溫而採取更激進的緊縮政策，甚至將利率推升至5%以上並主動倒置殖利率曲線，美股可能面臨明顯的本益比壓縮風險。
美銀證券表示，即使8月通膨數據的組成未達到引發重大警戒的程度，也不太可能為聯準會提供足夠理由延後升息。
因此，9月11日公布的CPI，將成為近期聯準會政策方向的重要考驗。
CPI公布後，8月PCE數據預計於9月底揭曉，時間點將落在聯準會9月利率決策會議約兩週後。
花旗指出，本次8月PCE數據的不確定性高於往常，原因在於聯準會近期調整部分關鍵分項的方法論，使CPI與PPI數據套用至PCE的傳統推估關係變得較不清晰。
此外，過去5年的PCE歷史數據也將進行修訂，花旗預期可能使核心PCE年增率下修逾30個基點至約3.0%。相關技術性調整，也將增加市場解讀最終PCE數據的難度。

items.title: 〈台股風向球〉聯準會升息壓抑難脫整理格局 先靠績優股輪流維繫多頭火種
items.title_en: [Taiwan Stock Market Outlook] Fed Rate Hikes Suppress, Hard to Break Out of Consolidation; Reliance on Blue‑Chip Stocks to Keep Bullish Sparks Alive
paras: 台股加權指數上周小彈219點，看似起伏不大，但從單日走勢來看卻呈現大跌又大漲格局，外資則終結連4周買超，台股交易員指出，目前短線交易難度相當高，加上市場預期美國聯準會9月升息的機率達60%，籌碼面的壓力令區間整理格局難以突破，較好的狀況是盤整緩步墊高支撐，而美國總統川普施壓聯準會該降息，能否挹注另一波多頭信心仍有待觀察。
由於美國聯準會9月升息壓力增，上周外資賣超709.72億元，自營含避險賣超218.22億元，主要是投信買超70.55億元力穩多方信心。
觀察外資一周來主要賣超元大台灣50反1(00632R-TW)近9.4萬張，南亞科(2408-TW)6.4萬張，華邦電(2344-TW)近5萬張，聯電(2303-TW)4.3萬張，力積電(6770-TW)近4萬張，群益臺灣加權正2(00685L-TW)共3.6萬張，京元電子(2449-TW)3.4萬張。
台股交易員認為，隨著上市櫃公司進入營收密集發布期，基本面好的個股可望持續挹注多頭火種，不過，美國升息引發的系統性壓力如影隨形，留意反彈有壓。
永豐投顧表示，股市受到聯準會官員談話和利率預期變化影響，同時，市場持續觀察美國期中選舉前後政策和財政方向變化，因此，市場處在盤整階段，短期不容易有突破表現。
尤其美國通膨無法降溫，美國10年期公債殖利率已突破4.7%，雖聯準會態度搖擺，但利率緩慢走高，惟可期待，依過去經驗來看，美國期中大選前的盤整觀望將在選前約一個月結束。
paras_en: The Taiwan Weighted Index rose modestly by 219 points last week, appearing relatively stable, but the daily price action showed a pattern of sharp drops followed by sharp gains. Foreign investors ended a four‑week streak of net buying. Traders noted that short‑term trading is currently very difficult, and with a 60% market probability of a Fed rate hike in September, the pressure on capital flows makes it hard for the range‑bound pattern to break. The best scenario is a gradual upward shift of support during the consolidation, while President Trump’s pressure on the Fed to cut rates may or may not inject another wave of bullish confidence.

Because of heightened pressure for a September Fed hike, foreign investors sold a net NT$70.972 billion last week, with proprietary and hedging sales accounting for a net NT$21.822 billion. Institutional investors (mutual funds) bought a net NT$7.055 billion, helping to steady bullish sentiment.

Foreign investors’ main net sales over the week were: Yuanta Taiwan 50 Reverse 1 (00632R‑TW) about 94,000 contracts, Nanya Technology (2408‑TW) 64,000 contracts, Winbond Electronics (2344‑TW) nearly 50,000 contracts, United Microelectronics (2303‑TW) 43,000 contracts, Lichih Semiconductor (6770‑TW) close to 40,000 contracts, Quanta Taiwan Weighted Index Positive 2 (00685L‑TW) 36,000 contracts, and Jingyuan Electronics (2449‑TW) 34,000 contracts.

Traders believe that as listed companies enter a period of intensive earnings releases, fundamentally strong stocks can continue to feed bullish momentum. However, systemic pressure from U.S. rate hikes remains ever‑present, so any rebound should be viewed with caution.

Yong‑Feng Investment Advisory notes that the market is being influenced by Fed officials’ remarks and shifting rate expectations. At the same time, investors are closely watching policy and fiscal changes surrounding the U.S. midterm elections, keeping the market in a consolidation phase with little chance of a short‑term breakout.

Especially as U.S. inflation remains stubborn, the 10‑year Treasury yield has breached 4.7%. Although the Fed’s stance is wavering, rates are inching higher. Historically, the consolidation and wait‑and‑see period before a U.S. midterm election tends to end about a month before the vote.

items.title: AI多頭等待的突破終於來了？高盛：OpenAI Astra模型「脫穎而出」
paras: OpenAI新一代Astra模型橫空出世，市場重新燃起對AI「智慧突破」的期待，高盛更認為，若模型能力持續大幅躍升，AI產業可能迎來新一輪需求擴張，進一步延長資本支出週期；然而，在軟銀、甲骨文(ORCL-US) 等相關個股率先上漲之際，日元升值、能源供應風險與聯準會（Fed）即將公布的CPI數據，仍可能成為這波AI樂觀情緒能否延續的關鍵考驗。
高盛Delta One交易台主管Rich Privorotsky在最新市場簡報中指出，Astra的表現具有重大意義，模型能力明顯領先同業，這類實質性的「智慧突破」正是AI多頭長期等待的訊號。
市場也迅速反映這項消息。OpenAI重要投資者軟銀股價隔夜大漲逾10%，由於軟銀持有OpenAI投資部位，其股價經常被視為OpenAI估值變化的市場映射；甲骨文股價也上漲約5.5%。
不過，Privorotsky認為，相關個股上漲反而不是這次事件最值得關注的部分。真正重要的是，如果AI模型能力持續出現跨越式進展，可能重新擴大企業可開發的應用範圍，進而支撐整體AI支出週期。

模型變便宜與模型變聰明，是兩回事

Privorotsky特別區分AI模型「降價」與「能力提升」對市場需求帶來的不同影響。
如果只是token價格下降，企業主要是以更低成本使用既有的AI能力；但若模型本身出現實質性的智慧躍升，企業將可能開始開發過去因技術限制而無法實現的新應用，AI需求曲線也會因此重新擴張。
他指出，真正的智慧突破不僅會改變需求，也會迫使其他AI實驗室持續追趕，進一步維持整個產業的支出動能，並強化市場對「仍有更好的AI應用值得開發」的預期。
Privorotsky也針對先前「token需求增速可能追不上token成本下降」的觀點進一步說明。他認為，只有在模型能力沒有出現根本性進步的情況下，算力供給過剩才可能成為問題；Astra的出現則顯示，目前市場可能正朝另一個方向發展。

OpenAI喊「代際飛躍」 AI競爭轉向智能能力

Astra在部分與AGI相關的基準測試中展現強勁表現，也讓OpenAI對模型能力給出高度評價。
OpenAI總裁Greg Brockman形容Astra可能成為AGI發展的重要節點。面對Astra是否已符合AGI定義的問題，他則直接表示：「我認為就是這個模型。」
不過，目前業界對AGI仍沒有統一的定義與標準化測試方式，Brockman也指出，最終仍應由使用者來判斷。
分析指出，這也反映AI產業競爭正在發生變化。市場競爭不再只是圍繞模型價格與運算效率，而是逐步轉向模型「智慧」本身的較量。
對AI多頭而言，如果模型領先優勢能持續透過能力提升體現，將有助於重新建立市場對AI資本支出週期延續性的信心。

日元走強 日銀升息預期與財政擴張同時出現

除了AI題材之外，Privorotsky也將焦點放在日元走勢。
近期日元持續走強，但目前尚未看到明顯的市場干預跡象；另一方面，市場對日本央行（BOJ）的政策預期轉向更為鷹派，目前已反映9月升息幅度略高於25個基點，以及未來一年累計升息接近100個基點的預期。
與貨幣政策收緊形成對比的是，日本財政政策仍在擴張。Privorotsky指出，日本2027財年預算申請總額已達143.1兆日元。
財政擴張與貨幣緊縮同時存在，加上日元升值，形成目前日本市場值得關注的政策組合。日元升值可能對出口商造成壓力，但日本銀行股則可能持續受惠，Topix銀行指數已升至今年高點。
此外，日元升值也可能削弱市場上的套息交易，進而對全球風險資產構成壓力。

能源供應風險仍是市場最大變數

相較於AI帶來的樂觀情緒，能源市場仍是Privorotsky認為最需要關注的宏觀風險。
荷姆茲海峽航運目前仍受到嚴重干擾。雖然美國已證明能夠護航大型原油船隊通過海峽，但更廣泛的供應問題仍未獲得解決，成品油與液化天然氣（LNG）運輸依然受到阻礙，庫存也持續承受壓力。
Privorotsky認為，目前的供應狀態難以長期維持，因此能源價格仍可能成為市場風險偏好最大的干擾因素。
他也警告，周末期間中東局勢可能出現新的升級或降溫變化；另一方面，隨著美國國內政治因素的重要性提高，未來也可能出現推動中東局勢緩和的機會。
俄烏局勢近期也出現一些外交層面的正面訊號，但Privorotsky認為，市場目前仍不宜對和平前景抱持過高期待。

聯準會等待CPI AI樂觀情緒面臨宏觀數據考驗

在美國貨幣政策方面，市場正逐步尋找聯準會維持利率不變的可能路徑。此前聯準會官員沃勒（Christopher Waller）的言論也顯示，決策核心目前並未出現明顯政策轉向，後續仍將取決於經濟數據。
因此，市場焦點已逐漸從就業數據轉向下周公布的消費者物價指數（CPI）。
經歷8月市場震盪後，投資人持倉已經有所下降，先前表現不佳的共識交易與動能交易也有所降溫。
Privorotsky認為，只要CPI沒有出現明顯的上行意外，風險資產仍存在進一步走強的空間。在這種情況下，Astra所重新點燃的AI投資敘事，也可能成為市場新的推動力量。
接下來市場將迎來甲骨文財報，以及一系列科技產業會議。投資人將從雲端基礎設施與AI業務等領域尋找更多訊號，觀察模型能力突破能否進一步轉化為產業需求與資本支出。
不過，能源價格仍是市場必須留意的主要風險，德國薩克森－安哈特邦周末舉行的選舉同樣受到關注。

items.title: Anthropic掛牌倒數 多檔槓桿ETF蓄勢待發 連Claude都建議別碰
items.title_en: Anthropic Nears IPO Countdown, Multiple Leveraged ETFs Poised, Even Claude Advises Against It
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司Anthropic可能還要數週才會上市，但基金業者已摩拳擦掌，準備推出個股ETF，讓投資人放大押注這家AI公司的股價表現。
Claude開發商Anthropic已祕密遞交首次公開募股（IPO）申請，預計未來幾週內正式提交公開文件。這意味Anthropic股票最快可能於本月稍晚或10月掛牌交易，屆時投資人將有多檔個股ETF可供選擇，押注這檔AI新股。
不過，策略師甚至AI本身都警告，這類產品波動劇烈，投資人必須具備極高的風險承受能力，並不適合採取長期買進持有策略。
多家基金業者布局槓桿產品
Direxion、Tradr、Leverage Shares及GraniteShares等基金公司，均已公布計畫，準備在Anthropic股票開始交易後不久，推出與其掛鉤的槓桿ETF。REX Shares與Tuttle Capital Management也早在今年3月申請推出純做多的Anthropic ETF。
槓桿型個股ETF透過選擇權、交換合約及期貨等衍生性金融商品，放大所追蹤個股或指數的每日漲跌幅，常見產品為2倍槓桿。
例如，若某檔股票單日上漲2%，其2倍做多ETF理論上應上漲4%；相反地，2倍放空或反向ETF則應下跌4%。若該股票下跌2%，2倍反向ETF理論上則會上漲4%。
這類產品聽起來風險很高，事實也確實如此。當被問及個股ETF整體而言是否安全時，Anthropic旗下Claude給出的回答相當直接。
Claude表示：「簡短答案是：不安全。」它並指出，個別公司的所有特有風險，包括財報不如預期、訴訟及執行長爭議等，都會被槓桿進一步放大。
Claude還表示，由於每日槓桿會產生複利效應，這類產品通常是為短線交易設計，而非供投資人長期買進持有。
每日重設恐使報酬偏離預期
這項提醒完全切中要點。推出相關產品的基金公司均謹慎說明，槓桿ETF會每日重設，因此容易受到短期波動影響。換句話說，當標的股票持續上漲時，做多ETF的長期漲幅可能不如投資人預期；若股價一路走高，反向ETF的跌幅則可能遠超想像。
以GraniteShares 2倍做多輝達(NVDA-US) 每日ETF為例，該基金今年來上漲28.6%，並未達到輝達2026年迄今23.5%漲幅的兩倍。另一方面，GraniteShares 2倍放空輝達每日ETF今年已暴跌近50%。
提出警告的也不只有Claude。市場專家同樣認為，個股ETF並非一般投資人可以輕易承受的產品。
晨星北美ETF與被動式策略研究主管Bryan Armour近期在報告中形容，個股ETF就像金融市場的懸浮滑板，沒有太多實際用途，卻可能隨時起火爆炸。
Armour指出，過去4年個股ETF的報酬率中位數為負38%；自成立以來，有19%的個股ETF虧損超過75%，僅18%的產品表現優於其追蹤的股票。
業者坦言只適合短線交易
基金公司本身也強調，這些產品並非長期投資工具。Direxion執行長Douglas Yones向《巴隆周刊》表示，這類ETF是為交易者設計，並提醒投資人注意槓桿相關風險。
GraniteShares執行長Will Rhind則表示，SpaceX的案例顯示，市場對指標性IPO相關交易工具的需求不僅立即浮現，而且多空雙方都相當旺盛。
Rhind指出，當一家公司以創紀錄的估值掛牌時，許多交易者都希望透過明確工具，表達對其估值是否過高的看法。他預期，Anthropic上市後也會出現同樣強勁的雙向交易需求。
然而，散戶未必會依照產品原先設定的方式操作。
盈透證券首席策略師Steve Sosnick表示，他理解槓桿對積極型交易客戶具有吸引力，但仍不相信這些產品都被投資人嚴格按照原定用途使用。
熱門新股掛牌後ETF迅速跟進
Anthropic相關ETF計畫並不令人意外。今年槓桿ETF人氣大增，交易者紛紛湧入與SanDisk、美光等熱門股票，以及費城半導體(SOX) 掛鉤的基金。
資產管理業者也因此加快推出與新上市公司連結的產品。SpaceX(SPCX-US) 與SK海力士(SKHY-US) 股票在美國掛牌交易後，僅過數天便有多檔相關ETF上市。
不過，想投資Anthropic仍有其他投機程度較低的方式。最直接的選擇，是等待IPO啟動後，設法在掛牌前取得股票配售。券商可能比照SpaceX上市時的做法，保留部分股份供散戶申購；投資人也可以等股票正式掛牌後，直接在次級市場買進。
部分ETF已提前持有Anthropic
對於不願等待的投資人，目前已有部分ETF透過持有私人股權的特殊目的工具，提前取得Anthropic尚未上市股份的曝險。

根據晨星資料，Tema Photonics & Optical ETF、Tema Electrification ETF、Alger Concentrated Equity ETF、Alger AI Enablers & Adopters ETF、Alger 35 ETF、iShares A.I. Innovation and Tech Active ETF、T. Rowe Price Capital Appreciation Equity ETF及T. Rowe Price Technology ETF，均持有Anthropic上市前股份。
IPO本身的風險已經不低，若再疊加槓桿，風險只會進一步放大。希望參與Anthropic成長的投資人，較穩健的做法可能是選擇持有該公司的多元化基金，或待Anthropic掛牌後直接買進普通股。
畢竟，就連Claude似乎也認為，Anthropic個股ETF並不是一個理想選擇。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic may still be weeks away from listing, but fund managers are already gearing up to launch single-stock ETFs that let investors amplify bets on the AI company's stock performance.

Anthropic, the developer of Claude, has quietly filed an IPO application and is expected to submit public documents in the coming weeks. This means Anthropic shares could debut as early as later this month or in October, at which point investors will have several single-stock ETFs to choose from to wager on the new AI stock.

However, strategists and even the AI itself warn that such products are highly volatile, requiring investors to have a very high risk tolerance and are unsuitable for a long‑term buy‑and‑hold approach.
Multiple fund managers line up leveraged products

Direxion, Tradr, Leverage Shares, GraniteShares and others have announced plans to roll out leveraged ETFs linked to Anthropic shortly after its stock begins trading. REX Shares and Tuttle Capital Management also applied in March to launch a pure long Anthropic ETF.
Leveraged single‑stock ETFs use options, swaps and futures to magnify the daily price movement of the underlying stock or index, with the most common offering 2× leverage.

For example, if a stock rises 2% in a day, a 2× long ETF would theoretically rise 4%; conversely, a 2× short or inverse ETF would fall 4%. If the stock falls 2%, a 2× inverse ETF would theoretically rise 4%.
These products sound extremely risky, and they indeed are. When asked whether single‑stock ETFs are safe overall, Anthropic’s Claude gave a very direct answer.
Claude said, "Short answer: not safe." It noted that all company‑specific risks—missed earnings, lawsuits, CEO controversies—are amplified by leverage.
Claude also pointed out that daily leverage creates a compounding effect, making these products generally designed for short‑term trading rather than long‑term holding.
Daily reset can cause returns to diverge from expectations

That reminder hits the nail on the head. Fund firms launching the products caution that leveraged ETFs reset daily, making them vulnerable to short‑term volatility. In other words, when the underlying stock keeps climbing, the long ETF’s cumulative gain may fall short of expectations; if the stock keeps falling, the inverse ETF’s loss can far exceed what investors anticipate.

Take GraniteShares’ 2× long Nvidia (NVDA‑US) daily ETF as an example: it’s up about 28.6% this year, well below twice Nvidia’s roughly 23.5% gain through 2026. By contrast, GraniteShares’ 2× short Nvidia daily ETF has plunged nearly 50% this year.
Claude isn’t the only one issuing warnings. Market experts also agree that single‑stock ETFs are not products the average investor can easily bear.

Morningstar North America’s ETF and passive‑strategy head Bryan Armour recently described single‑stock ETFs as “floating skateboards in the financial market—little practical use but capable of catching fire at any moment.”

Armour noted that over the past four years the median return of single‑stock ETFs has been –38%; since inception, 19% of them have lost more than 75%, and only 18% have outperformed the stocks they track.
Managers admit they’re only suitable for short‑term trading

Fund firms themselves stress that these products are not long‑term investment tools. Direxion CEO Douglas Yones told Barron’s that such ETFs are built for traders and warned investors about leverage‑related risks.
GraniteShares CEO Will Rhind said the SpaceX case shows demand for IPO‑linked trading tools spikes immediately, with strong interest on both the long and short sides.

Rhind added that when a company lists at a record valuation, many traders want a clear instrument to express whether they think the price is too high. He expects the same robust two‑way demand after Anthropic lists.
However, retail investors may not use the products as originally intended.
Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick said he sees leverage appealing to aggressive traders but doubts that investors consistently use these products for their intended purpose.
Hot new‑issue ETFs follow listings quickly

Anthropic‑related ETF plans are unsurprising. Leveraged ETFs have surged in popularity this year, with traders flocking to products tied to hot stocks like SanDisk, Micron and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX).

Asset managers are accelerating the launch of products linked to newly listed companies. After SpaceX (SPCX‑US) and SK Hynix (SKHY‑US) began trading in the U.S., several related ETFs were launched within days.

Nevertheless, there are lower‑speculation ways to invest in Anthropic. The simplest is to wait for the IPO and try to obtain an allocation before the shares hit the market. Brokers may, as with SpaceX, reserve a portion of shares for retail allocation; investors can also buy the stock on the secondary market once it lists.
Some ETFs already hold Anthropic ahead of the IPO
For investors unwilling to wait, certain ETFs have used special purpose vehicles that hold private‑equity stakes to gain exposure to Anthropic before its public debut.

According to Morningstar, the Tema Photonics & Optical ETF, Tema Electrification ETF, Alger Concentrated Equity ETF, Alger AI Enablers & Adopters ETF, Alger 35 ETF, iShares A.I. Innovation and Tech Active ETF, T. Rowe Price Capital Appreciation Equity ETF and T. Rowe Price Technology ETF all own pre‑IPO Anthropic shares.

The IPO itself carries significant risk, and adding leverage only magnifies it. Investors seeking Anthropic’s growth might be better off holding diversified funds that include the company or buying its ordinary shares after the listing.
After all, even Claude seems to think that an Anthropic single‑stock ETF is not an ideal choice.

items.title: 輝達砸130億美元收購Hugging Face 分析師：如同買「健康保險」
items.title_en: Nvidia Spends $13 B to Acquire Hugging Face, Analyst Says It's Like Buying "Health Insurance"
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 向來擅長透過投資維持晶片霸主地位，一名分析師認為，收購 Hugging Face 正是最新案例。
獨立研究機構 Radio Free Mobile 創辦人溫莎（Richard Windsor）表示，面對客製化晶片競爭日益加劇，輝達斥資 130 億美元收購這座開源人工智慧（AI）平台，可視為替自身購買一份「健康保險」。
溫莎認為，這筆交易的目的，在於確保沒有任何業者能夠壟斷 AI 模型及其衍生服務。他在周五發布的客戶報告中指出，對輝達而言，此舉將大幅有助於維持其在晶片市場的競爭優勢。
輝達企業 AI 副總裁博伊塔諾（Justin Boitano）上周四在交易公布後的電話會議上表示，公司有充分誘因與動力，讓 Hugging Face 維持開放與中立，使平台上超過 1,800 萬名 AI 開發者都能在任何平台執行模型並存取資料集。
溫莎表示，讓 Hugging Face 保持獨立，最符合輝達自身利益，因為這有助於避免市場占有率流向自行研發晶片的 AI 服務供應商。
溫莎指出，輝達能夠維持 AI 晶片市場領先地位，關鍵在於統一運算架構 CUDA。這套平台讓開發者能利用輝達繪圖處理器（GPU）執行通用運算任務。此外，輝達每年推出新產品的節奏，也使其至少領先競爭對手一個晶片世代。
然而，隨著 AI 產業重心轉向推論，也就是 AI 模型根據所學內容進行預測的過程，溫莎認為，輝達透過 CUDA 掌握的優勢正在減弱。CUDA 在模型訓練時代曾是輝達的重要護城河，但在涵蓋硬體到服務的完整 AI 技術堆疊中，其影響力主要仍局限於晶片層。
溫莎表示，如果 Hugging Face 能持續成為開源 AI 模型的首選平台，「就不會有任何一家業者能夠壟斷 AI 服務市場」，而這正是輝達影響力相對有限的領域。
他也點出 Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 旗下 Google 與 Anthropic 等公司的潛在威脅。這些業者正自行開發客製化晶片，用於支援自家 AI 產品與服務。溫莎表示，如果其中一家公司成為「AI 服務的主導推動者」，整個 AI 生態系便可能輕易轉向針對其自研晶片進行最佳化。
他警告，這不僅會削弱輝達的定價能力，還可能導致其流失「大量」市場占有率。
因此，只要開源 AI 模型能繼續作為前沿 AI 實驗室與大型雲端服務商封閉模型的「可行且蓬勃發展的替代方案」，輝達就有望抵禦來自 AI 技術堆疊其他環節的競爭，尤其是自身相對不具優勢的領域。
溫莎補充，在獲得輝達大筆投資後，Hugging Face 如今可以更專注投入資源，並擴大其作為主要開源平台的角色。
William Blair 分析師納吉（Sebastien Naji）對輝達收購 Hugging Face 的策略也持相近看法。他在客戶報告中表示：「藉由將觸角延伸至模型層，輝達進一步拓寬了 CUDA 的應用入口。」
納吉指出，輝達也能因此更清楚掌握開源開發的發展方向，有助於公司規畫產品藍圖，繼續維持其作為 AI 基礎設施標準的地位。
他表示：「掌握模型開發趨勢，可作為因應 ASIC 市占率上升的避險手段。隨著 AI 實驗室愈來愈多採用客製化晶片執行封閉式前沿模型，這項能力也更加重要。」ASIC 指的是特殊應用積體電路，例如 OpenAI 與博通共同開發的 Jalapeño。
納吉認為，輝達支持開源生態系，有助於確保 AI 硬體需求來源更加廣泛，並讓更多價值流向商用 GPU 生態系。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) has long been adept at using investments to maintain its chip dominance, and an analyst says the acquisition of Hugging Face is the latest example.

Richard Windsor, founder of the independent research firm Radio Free Mobile, said that faced with intensifying competition in custom chips, Nvidia’s $13 billion purchase of the open‑source AI platform can be seen as buying a form of "health insurance" for itself.

Windsor believes the purpose of the deal is to ensure no single player can monopolize AI models and their downstream services, noting in a client report released on Friday that the move will greatly help Nvidia preserve its competitive edge in the chip market.

Justin Boitano, Nvidia’s corporate AI vice‑president, said in a conference call after the announcement last Thursday that the company has strong incentives and motivation to keep Hugging Face open and neutral, allowing the platform’s more than 18 million AI developers to run models and access datasets on any platform.
Windsor said keeping Hugging Face independent is in Nvidia’s best interest because it helps prevent market share from flowing to AI service providers that develop their own chips.

Windsor pointed out that Nvidia’s ability to stay ahead in the AI chip market hinges on its unified computing architecture, CUDA, which lets developers use Nvidia GPUs for general‑purpose compute, and that Nvidia’s cadence of new product launches keeps it at least one chip generation ahead of rivals.

However, as the AI industry shifts toward inference—the phase where models make predictions based on what they have learned—Windsor believes Nvidia’s advantage through CUDA is waning. CUDA was a strong moat during the training era, but in a full AI stack that spans hardware to services its impact now largely remains at the chip layer.

Windsor said that if Hugging Face continues to be the preferred open‑source AI model platform, “no single player will be able to dominate the AI services market,” which is a domain where Nvidia’s influence is relatively limited.

He also highlighted potential threats from Alphabet’s Google and companies like Anthropic, which are developing custom chips to support their own AI products and services. Windsor warned that if any of them becomes the “dominant driver of AI services,” the entire AI ecosystem could easily shift to optimize for those proprietary chips.
He cautioned that this would not only erode Nvidia’s pricing power but could also cause it to lose a “large” share of the market.

Therefore, as long as open‑source AI models remain a viable and thriving alternative to the closed models of leading cloud providers and frontier AI labs, Nvidia can fend off competition from other layers of the AI stack, especially those where it lacks a clear advantage.
Windsor added that with Nvidia’s sizable investment, Hugging Face can now focus more resources on expanding its role as the primary open‑source platform.

Sebastien Naji, an analyst at William Blair, shares a similar view on Nvidia’s strategy. In his client note he wrote: “By extending its reach to the model layer, Nvidia further broadens the entry points for CUDA applications.”

Naji noted that this also gives Nvidia clearer insight into the direction of open‑source development, helping the company plan its product roadmap and maintain its status as the standard AI infrastructure provider.

He said, “Understanding model‑development trends can serve as a hedge against rising ASIC market share. As more AI labs adopt custom chips to run closed‑source frontier models, this capability becomes increasingly important.” ASIC refers to application‑specific integrated circuits, such as the Jalapeño chip co‑developed by OpenAI and Broadcom.
Naji believes Nvidia’s support of the open‑source ecosystem helps ensure a broader base of AI hardware demand and directs more value toward the commercial GPU ecosystem.

items.title: 美光股價重返1000美元大關能續攻嗎？《巴隆》解析：9月底財報成關鍵
items.title_en: Micron Stock Returns to $1,000 Level—Can It Keep Advancing? Barron’s Analysis: Q3 Earnings Critical
paras: 美光科技(MU-US) 股價在人工智慧（AI）題材重新升溫帶動下強勢走高，週五（5日）收盤首度站上每股1000美元，創8月中旬以來新高，市場持續關注AI基礎建設相關股票的資金動能。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，道瓊市場數據顯示，美光股價週五收盤上漲6.1%，收在1016.59美元，為8月17日以來首度收盤站上1000美元大關；該股本週累計上漲9%。
值得注意的是，美光股價逆勢走強之際，美股大盤表現相對疲弱。受到優於預期的就業數據影響，標普500指數週五下跌0.4%，道瓊工業指數下跌0.5%，那斯達克綜合指數也下跌0.3%。
市場對AI基礎建設相關股票重新燃起投資熱情，被視為推升美光股價的重要因素之一。OpenAI最新推出的GPT-6 Astra AI模型近期表現受到關注，早期基準測試結果亮眼，可能有助於緩解市場對OpenAI高達1.4兆美元支出承諾的疑慮。
其他記憶體公司方面，SK海力士(000660KS) 的美國存託憑證(SKHY-US) 上漲8.1%。SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 則大漲11.9%，成為當天標普500指數中表現最佳的股票。
不過，單日強漲仍不足以確認美光股價已重新確立上升趨勢。美光股價自6月觸及高點後，累計回落約20%，且自8月中旬以來持續在50日移動平均線附近震盪，目前該均線約位於935美元。
現階段市場仍難判斷50日線究竟已轉為股價支撐，或反而形成壓力。
後續值得關注的關鍵催化劑，將是美光即將公布的財報。公司預計在9月30日公布2026會計年度第4季財報，屆時業績與展望能否進一步推動股價突破，將成為市場觀察焦點。
值得一提的是，《巴隆》先前曾在美光股價站上1100美元附近時提出看法，認為美光股價仍存在翻倍的可能性。
paras_en: Micron Technology (MU-US) saw its share price surge strongly as AI themes regained momentum, closing on Friday (the 5th) above $1,000 for the first time and hitting a new high since mid‑August, with the market still watching capital flows into AI infrastructure stocks.

According to Barron’s Weekly, Dow Jones market data showed Micron’s shares closed up 6.1% on Friday at $1,016.59, marking the first closing above $1,000 since August 17, and the stock is up about 9% for the week.

It is noteworthy that Micron’s price rose against a relatively weak broader market. Following better‑than‑expected employment data, the S&P 500 fell 0.4% on Friday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average slipped 0.5%, and the Nasdaq Composite dropped 0.3%.

Renewed investor enthusiasm for AI‑infrastructure stocks is seen as a key driver behind Micron’s rally. OpenAI’s newly launched GPT‑6 Astra model has drawn attention for strong early benchmark results, which could help allay market concerns over OpenAI’s $1.4 trillion spending commitment.
Among other memory makers, SK Hynix’s (000660KS) American Depositary Receipt (SKHY‑US) rose 8.1%, while SanDisk (SNDKV‑US) jumped 11.9%, making it the best‑performing stock in the S&P 500 that day.

However, a single‑day surge is not enough to confirm that Micron’s price has re‑established an uptrend. Since peaking in June, Micron has fallen roughly 20% and has been trading near its 50‑day moving average since mid‑August, which currently sits around $935.
At this stage it remains unclear whether the 50‑day line has become a support level for the stock or is turning into resistance.

The next key catalyst to watch will be Micron’s upcoming earnings report. The company plans to release its FY 2026 Q4 results on September 30, and whether the performance and outlook can further push the price higher will be a focal point for the market.
It is worth noting that Barron’s previously commented when Micron’s price approached $1,100, suggesting the stock still had the potential to double.

items.title: 美前總統拜登兒子杭特：可能會參選2028總統大選
items.title_en: Former US President Biden's Son Hunter May Run for the 2028 Presidential Election
paras: 美國前總統拜登之子杭特(Hunter Biden)近日接受專訪時透露，不排除參選2028年美國總統，追隨父親腳步入主白宮。這番表態，標誌著這位長期被貼上「問題兒子」標籤的人物，正試圖改寫自己在美國政治中的角色。
《紐約郵報》上週六(5日)報導指出，56歲的杭特在WABC《Cats Roundtable》廣播節目被問及是否參選時表示，他最關心的是5000萬仍受毒癮問題困擾的美國人，並稱自己從政的最大資格是恪守法治，期望下任總統承諾遵守法治。
杭特過去曾因聯邦槍械及稅務罪名被定罪，並公開談及自己的毒癮問題。2014年，44歲的他因古柯鹼檢測呈陽性遭海軍開除；若當選總統，將是他事後首次涉足美國軍事體系。
拜登任副總統期間，杭特亦曾被指利用父親職位為家人牟利。亨特本身從事藝術創作，近日在播客節目談及個人生活，自稱有「48.6%」屬同性戀；他與3名女子育有5名子女。
長期以來，杭特在美國政治中的角色幾乎只有一個：拜登的「問題兒子」。吸毒、酗酒、烏克蘭能源公司Burisma、筆電風波及接踵而至的司法案件，讓他成為共和黨攻擊拜登家族最方便的靶子。
2024年，他因購買槍枝時隱瞞吸毒問題被聯邦陪審團定罪，隨後又對稅務指控認罪，最終拜登在卸任前給予兒子範圍極廣的總統赦免，這甚至違背了他此前多次公開作出的「不赦免」承諾。
換言之，在拜登執政時期，杭特最重要的政治功能一直是給父親製造麻煩。
但現在，他正試圖改寫這個角色。《華爾街日報》注意到，亨特近期展開一輪罕見的密集媒體曝光：接受新聞節目、播客和網路媒體訪問，經營自己的Substack，甚至主動與過去猛烈攻擊他的保守派人物對話。他談自己的毒癮、清醒經歷、父親的健康，也毫不避諱評論民主黨和美國政治。
這種變化的核心，是把過去最致命的負資產重新包裝成政治資產。過去，「吸毒者」意味失控和醜聞，如今杭特強調已長期保持清醒，並把成癮問題塑造成理解美國社會的特殊經驗。
過去，司法案件證明的是他給家族帶來的政治風險，現在他的敘事則轉為自身親身經歷司法調查、媒體圍攻和政治羞辱，因此比普通政治人物更理解權力、法治與政治鬥爭。
今年8月，拜登太太吉兒被問到若杭特想選總統自己會怎麼說，她的回答只有一個詞：「Run（去選）。」儘管她隨後強調這更多是父母對子女選擇的支持，但這個問題如今已能堂而皇之進入公開採訪，本身就說明問題。
當然，杭特距離真正成為2028年民主黨總統候選人還有極其遙遠的距離。他沒有傳統意義上的從政履歷，個人爭議巨大，民主黨內包括紐森等人早已被視為潛在競爭者，杭特在受訪中也提及這些名字。
因此，更準確的判斷不是「杭特準備競選總統」，而是他第一次開始希望公眾把他想像成一個政治人物。過去十多年，美國人認識他是因為其父是總統，他現在正嘗試讓美國人直接認識他本人。
paras_en: Hunter Biden, the son of former US President Joe Biden, recently told an interview that he does not rule out running for the US presidency in 2028, following his father’s footsteps into the White House. This statement marks the long‑time “problem son” attempting to rewrite his role in American politics.

The New York Post reported last Saturday (the 5th) that the 56‑year‑old Hunter, when asked on WABC’s “Cats Roundtable” radio show whether he would run, said his greatest concern is the 50 million Americans still struggling with drug addiction, and he claimed his biggest qualification for office is a commitment to the rule of law, hoping the next president will pledge to uphold it.

Hunter has previously been convicted of federal firearms and tax offenses and has spoken publicly about his drug addiction. In 2014, at age 44, he tested positive for cocaine and was discharged from the Navy; if he were elected president, it would be his first involvement with the US military establishment after that dismissal.

During Joe Biden’s vice‑presidential tenure, Hunter was accused of leveraging his father’s position for family profit. Hunter, an artist, recently discussed his personal life on a podcast, claiming he is “48.6%” homosexual; he has five children with three women.

For a long time, Hunter’s role in US politics has been essentially that of Biden’s “problem son.” His drug use, alcoholism, ties to Ukrainian energy firm Burisma, laptop scandal and a string of legal cases have made him the GOP’s favorite target against the Biden family.

In 2024 he was convicted by a federal jury for lying about his drug use when purchasing a gun, then pleaded guilty to tax charges, after which President Biden granted him an unusually broad presidential pardon before leaving office, even though he had repeatedly pledged publicly not to issue pardons.
In other words, during Biden’s administration, Hunter’s most important political function was to create trouble for his father.

Now he is trying to rewrite that role. The Wall Street Journal noted that Hunter has recently embarked on a rare, intensive media push: appearing on news shows, podcasts and online outlets, running his own Substack, and even engaging in dialogue with conservative figures who once attacked him. He talks about his addiction, sobriety, his father’s health, and does not shy away from commenting on the Democratic Party and US politics.

The core of this shift is repackaging his once‑deadly negative asset into a political one. Previously, “drug user” meant loss of control and scandal; now Hunter emphasizes his long‑term sobriety and frames his addiction experience as a unique insight into American society.

In the past, legal cases highlighted the political risk he posed to the family; now his narrative focuses on his personal experience of investigations, media attacks and political humiliation, claiming he therefore understands power, the rule of law and political battles better than ordinary politicians.

In August this year, when asked what she would say if Hunter wanted to run for president, First Lady Jill Biden’s answer was a single word: “Run.” Although she later stressed that it was more about parental support for a child’s choices, the fact that the question could be raised openly in an interview shows how the issue has entered mainstream discourse.

Of course, Hunter is still a long way from becoming the Democratic nominee for 2028. He lacks a traditional political résumé, carries huge personal controversies, and figures such as Nathan … have already been seen as potential contenders; Hunter even mentioned those names in the interview.

Thus, a more accurate assessment is not that “Hunter is preparing to run for president,” but that he is for the first time trying to get the public to imagine him as a political figure. For over a decade Americans have known him because his father was president; now he is trying to have Americans know him directly.

items.title: 美股「最佳祕密」曝！資深基金經理看好微型股、點名「這些股票」
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks’ “Best Secret” Revealed! Veteran Fund Manager Backs Micro‑Caps, Names Specific Stocks
paras: 大型科技股與超大型股近期幾乎主導了市場討論，但一位資深投資人表示，市場上規模最小的股票同樣值得關注。
根據《Business Insider》報導，富蘭克林坦伯頓旗下投資公司 Royce Investment Partners 投資組合經理 Jim Stoeffel表示，市值低於3億美元的微型股可能是市場中「最佳祕密」，投資人不應因其波動性較高而忽略這項資產類別。
Stoeffel指出，從2025年4月8日市場低點以來，微型股已持續領先美股市場超過一年，但有相當多的投資人對這項資產類別的存在都只有模糊的概念。
數據也顯示微型股近期的強勁表現。Stoeffel寫道，羅素微型股指數（Russell Microcap）上漲27.5%，相較之下，羅素2000小型股指數（Russell 2000）上漲22.6%、羅素1000大型股指數（Russell 1000）上漲10.3%，羅素50超大型股指數（Russell Top 50）則上漲2.0%。
Stoeffel認為，即使近期微型股已成為市場領漲族群，且整體表現普遍正向，但其在微型股市場幾乎每個角落，仍持續找到具有吸引力的買進機會。
不過，他也提醒，微型股波動程度較高，因此投資人若要將其納入投資組合，應採取主動管理策略。
Stoeffel表示，這類股票的特性是「出問題時，往往會出現相當大的問題；如果進展順利，表現也可能非常突出」。
在產業布局方面，儘管Stoeffel的團隊看好AI，他也同樣偏好軟體產業與就業服務。在科技與AI領域，Stoeffel表示，團隊針對微型股的投資策略，偏向尋找能夠受惠於資料中心熱潮的「賣鏟人」企業。
Stoeffel將DHI Group(DHX-US) 列為微型股中的首選之一，該股今年以來已上漲204%。DHI Group經營Stoeffel看好的兩大領域，透過營運一個專業化的職涯人才市場，讓投資人同時布局科技與就業服務兩大領域。
此外，雖然Ichor Holdings(ICHR-US) 與Mistras Group(MG-US) 的市值略高於微型股範圍，Stoeffel也將兩家公司列為其關注產業中的看好標的。兩家公司同樣屬於「賣鏟人」企業。
Mistras主要提供大型基礎建設的防護服務；Ichor則負責製造半導體設備次系統，客戶包括應用材料(AMAT-US) 與科林研發(LRCX-US) 。
針對Ichor，Stoeffel表示，近期AI相關股票普遍出現回檔，但在他看來，這反而讓相關標的重新具備吸引力。
paras_en: Large‑cap tech and mega‑cap stocks have dominated market talk lately, but a seasoned investor says the smallest‑cap stocks are also worth watching.

According to Business Insider, Jim Stoeffel, portfolio manager at Royce Investment Partners, a Franklin Templeton affiliate, says micro‑caps with market values under $300 million may be the market’s “best secret,” and investors shouldn’t overlook this asset class just because it’s more volatile.

Stoeffel notes that since the market low on April 8, 2025, micro‑caps have outperformed the broader U.S. market for more than a year, yet many investors still have only a vague notion of this asset class.

Data also show micro‑caps have been strong lately. Stoeffel writes that the Russell Microcap index is up 27.5%, versus a 22.6% gain in the Russell 2000 small‑cap index, a 10.3% rise in the Russell 1000 large‑cap index, and a 2.0% increase in the Russell Top 50 mega‑cap index.

Stoeffel believes that even though micro‑caps have become the market’s leading group and overall performance is broadly positive, attractive buying opportunities continue to appear in virtually every corner of the micro‑cap universe.
He cautions, however, that micro‑caps are highly volatile, so investors who add them to a portfolio should employ an active‑management approach.
Stoeffel says these stocks have the characteristic that “when problems arise, they tend to be huge; if things go well, performance can be spectacular.”

Regarding sector exposure, while his team is bullish on AI, they also favor software and employment‑services firms. In tech and AI, the team’s micro‑cap strategy leans toward “shovel‑seller” companies that stand to benefit from the data‑center boom.

Stoeffel lists DHI Group (DHX‑US) as a top micro‑cap pick, a stock that has risen 204% year‑to‑date. DHI operates in two areas Stoeffel likes, running a specialized career‑talent marketplace that gives investors exposure to both technology and employment‑services sectors.

He also flags Ichor Holdings (ICHR‑US) and Mistras Group (MG‑US) – whose market caps sit just above the micro‑cap range – as favored names in his target industries. Both are also “shovel‑seller” companies.

Mistras provides protective services for large‑scale infrastructure, while Ichor manufactures semiconductor‑equipment subsystems for customers such as Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) and Lam Research (LRCX‑US).
On Ichor, Stoeffel notes that AI‑related stocks have recently pulled back, but in his view that retreat actually makes the related targets more attractive again.

items.title: 川普支持率剩40% 期中選舉恐變天！美銀點名債券是Q4逆勢贏家
items.title_en: Trump Approval at 40% Raises Midterm Election Stakes; Bank of America Calls Bonds Q4 Contrarian Winners
paras: 若以美國總統川普支持率僅介於35%至40%來看，民主黨在期中選舉一舉拿下參議院與眾議院的可能性正持續升高。美國銀行(BAC-US) 首席股票策略師認為，這將成為重大避險事件，可能導致股市與美元重挫，債券則有望一路上漲至年底。
美銀策略師哈特奈特（Michael Hartnett）指出，民主黨若全面掌控國會，最令股市擔憂的是，美國政策可能從「民粹資本主義」轉向「民粹社會主義」，並扭轉低稅負與放寬監管的趨勢。其結果將不利每股盈餘（EPS），促使市場下修獲利預期；整體而言，政治情勢變化也將挑戰K型財富成長，以及AI資本支出的熱潮。
這項預測的邏輯是，若市場預期民主黨政策將導致經濟成長放緩，債券殖利率將隨之下滑，美元也會因與其他貨幣的利差縮小而走弱。
因此，在哈特奈特所稱近期「除了債券什麼都買」（Anything But Bonds）的時代過後，買進債券將是一項真正的逆勢布局。
事實上，美國公債過去10年的滾動報酬率為負2%，創下近百年最差表現。哈特奈特在周五發布的每周《資金流向》策略報告中指出，美債長期報酬率跌至負值，過去往往是絕佳的進場時機，例如1959年12月與1981年9月。
美國期中選舉顯然已成為政府與投資人關注的焦點。哈特奈特認為，這也使部分關鍵數字的重要性大幅升高，包括每加侖4美元的汽油價格、美元兌日元160價位，以及美國長天期公債殖利率5%關卡。
這些數字攸關選民觀感，也解釋了現任政府為何出手干預匯市與債市，並竭力透過言論壓低油價。
哈特奈特指出，各國央行正收緊貨幣政策，試圖重建政策公信力並遏止債券殖利率飆升。
例如，市場對歐洲央行9月10日升息的機率定價已達99%；Fed在9月16日升息1碼的機率則各占一半；日本銀行也普遍被預期將在9月18日會議上收緊貨幣政策。
paras_en: If President Trump’s approval rating hovers between 35% and 40%, the Democrats’ chance of sweeping both the Senate and the House in the midterms is rising. Bank of America (BAC-US) chief equity strategist says this could become a major hedging event, potentially sending stocks and the dollar sharply lower while bonds could climb all the way to year‑end.

Bank of America strategist Michael Hartnett notes that a full Democratic takeover of Congress would worry equity markets most because U.S. policy could shift from “populist capitalism” to “populist socialism,” reversing low‑tax and deregulation trends. The result would hurt earnings per share, prompting the market to cut profit forecasts; overall, the political shift would also challenge K‑shaped wealth growth and the AI‑capital‑spending boom.

The logic behind this view is that if the market expects Democratic policies to slow economic growth, bond yields would fall and the dollar would weaken as its interest‑rate differential with other currencies narrows.
Thus, after what Hartnett calls the recent “Anything But Bonds” era, buying bonds would become a genuine contrarian play.

In fact, U.S. Treasury bonds have posted a rolling 10‑year return of minus 2%, the worst performance in nearly a century. Hartnett’s weekly “Fund Flow” strategy note released on Friday points out that when long‑term Treasury returns turn negative, history has often provided excellent entry points, such as December 1959 and September 1981.

The U.S. midterm election has clearly become a focal point for both the government and investors. Hartnett says this also elevates the importance of several key numbers, including gasoline at $4 per gallon, the dollar‑yen pair around 160, and the 5% threshold for long‑term U.S. Treasury yields.
These figures affect voter perception and explain why the incumbent administration is intervening in the foreign‑exchange and bond markets, actively using rhetoric to push oil prices lower.
Hartnett notes that central banks worldwide are tightening monetary policy to restore policy credibility and curb soaring bond yields.

For example, the market is pricing a 99% probability of an ECB rate hike on September 10, a 50% chance of a Fed hike on September 16, and expectations that the Bank of Japan will tighten policy at its September 18 meeting.

items.title: 別被亮眼非農騙了 8月就業報告其實利多債市
items.title_en: Don’t Be Fooled by the Shiny Nonfarm Numbers—August Employment Report Is Actually Bullish for Bonds
paras: 《MarketWatch》觀點專欄指出，分析華爾街權威人士說法，彷彿上周五公布的最新就業數據顯示，美國勞工的處境從未如此美好。遺憾的是，對美國勞工而言，事實並非如此。
仔細觀察便會發現，這波僅維持一個月的表面就業榮景，主要來自夏季新增的低薪餐旅業職缺，以及地方政府為迎接新學年提前聘用教師。
據稱8月非農就業人口增加16.2萬人，其中上述兩類職缺合計就占10.3萬人，接近總數的三分之二。至於原本應受惠於人工智慧（AI）泡沫式瘋狂支出、景氣火熱的高薪資訊科技業，實際上反而減少就業。
在這場所謂的就業盛宴中，平均時薪漲幅其實不敵通膨。若以實質購買力計算，勞工的處境反而變差。
美國勞工部指出，7月至8月平均時薪成長0.3%；但克里夫蘭聯準銀行數據顯示，同期消費者物價上漲0.4%。勞工部也表示，過去12個月平均時薪成長3.1%；然而克里夫蘭聯準銀行指出，同期消費者物價漲幅達3.4%。
這是尷尬的情景。
更何況，這還是一個靠大舉舉債刺激的經濟。這份就業數據公布前，美國聯邦政府才剛在7月掀起舉債狂潮，當月財政赤字較前一個月暴增近3倍，達到4,320億美元。
換句話說，美國聯邦政府在7月發行的債務，相當於每戶家庭負擔約3,200美元，接著將這筆錢花掉。儘管餐廳因此增聘大批服務生、清潔人員、洗碗工與廚師，全美實質薪資卻仍然下滑。
而這還不是問題的全貌。就在勞動節前夕，美國勞工部還公布，美國勞工目前分得的全國經濟產出比重，已降至有紀錄以來最低。
勞工部上周四表示，第二季勞動報酬占國內生產毛額（GDP）的「勞動所得份額」降至僅52.8%。勞工部指出，勞動所得份額是指勞工以薪酬形式取得的產出比重，2026年第二季降至52.8%，創1947年第一季開始統計以來最低。
這項數據甚至尚未反映第二季結束後兩個月的情況。
當然，這些趨勢並非近期才出現，也曾助川普在2016年及2024年贏得總統大選。但自2024年第四季以來，這項數據又下降整整2個百分點。換句話說，跌勢始於拜登仍擔任總統期間，多少有些難堪。
待塵埃落定後，這些情況遲早應會轉化為債市利多。
目前華爾街預期，聯準會（Fed）未來一年將升息3次，並自本月開始。最新就業數據公布後，已有少數市場人士開始揣測，Fed是否可能升息4次，使利率在一年後升至4.5%至4.75%。
Fed調高短期利率時，等於向債市釋放警戒通膨的訊號，通常有助緩解市場對長期通膨的擔憂，進而壓低長期利率。債券價格與殖利率如同翹翹板，殖利率下降時，債券價格便會上漲。因此，若Fed積極升息，尤其實體經濟遠不如華爾街宣稱的強勁，最終很可能反而有利債市。
更不用說，Fed未來可能被迫以某種方式因應急遽攀升的財政赤字，重新啟動「量化寬鬆」，透過新創造的貨幣購買美國公債。
鑑於近期債市低迷，值得注意的是，被稱為TIPS的美國抗通膨債券，可望在中長期每年跑贏通膨2%至3%。
這與一般工作的情況截然不同。即使處於所謂的就業榮景，薪資漲幅顯然仍完全追不上通膨。
paras_en: MarketWatch’s opinion column notes that, based on statements from Wall Street authorities, the latest employment data released last Friday seem to suggest that American workers have never been in a better position. Unfortunately, the reality for U.S. workers is not that rosy.

A close look reveals that this one‑month‑long surface‑level employment boom is mainly driven by low‑wage hospitality jobs added over the summer and by local governments hiring teachers early for the new school year.

August’s non‑farm payrolls are reported to have risen by 162,000, of which the two categories mentioned above account for 103,000 – roughly two‑thirds of the total. By contrast, the high‑paying information‑technology sector, which should have benefited from the AI‑driven spending frenzy and a hot economy, actually shed jobs.
In this so‑called employment feast, average hourly wage growth still lags behind inflation. When measured in real purchasing power, workers are actually worse off.

The U.S. Labor Department says average hourly earnings grew 0.3% from July to August, while Cleveland Fed data show consumer prices rose 0.4% over the same period. Over the past 12 months, average hourly earnings rose 3.1%, but the Cleveland Fed reports a 3.4% rise in consumer prices during that span.
It’s an awkward picture.

Moreover, this is an economy propped up by massive borrowing. Just before the jobs data were released, the federal government had launched a borrowing spree in July, with the fiscal deficit that month swelling nearly three‑fold from the previous month to $432 billion.

In other words, the debt issued by the U.S. government in July translates to about $3,200 per household, which was then spent. Even though restaurants hired large numbers of servers, cleaners, dishwashers and cooks, real wages across the country still fell.
And that’s not the whole story. On the eve of Labor Day, the Labor Department announced that the share of national economic output going to workers has fallen to a record low.

The department said that in the second quarter the labor share of gross domestic product (GDP) slipped to just 52.8%. The labor share—defined as the proportion of output paid to workers as compensation—dropped to 52.8% in Q2 2026, the lowest since the series began in Q1 1947.
That figure does not even reflect the two months following the end of the second quarter.

Of course, these trends are not new and helped Trump win the presidency in 2016 and again in 2024. Since Q4 2024, however, the labor share has fallen a full two percentage points, meaning the decline began while Biden was still president, which is somewhat embarrassing.
When the dust settles, these conditions should eventually translate into a tailwind for the bond market.

Wall Street currently expects the Fed to raise rates three times over the next year, starting this month. After the latest jobs numbers, a few market participants began speculating whether the Fed might raise rates four times, pushing the policy rate to 4.5%‑4.75% in a year’s time.

When the Fed hikes short‑term rates, it signals to the bond market that it is vigilant about inflation, which usually eases concerns about long‑term inflation and pushes long‑term yields lower. Bond prices and yields move on a seesaw: yields fall, prices rise. Thus, if the Fed aggressively raises rates while the real economy is far weaker than Wall Street claims, it could ultimately be good for bonds.
Furthermore, the Fed may eventually be forced to respond to a sharply rising fiscal deficit by restarting some form of quantitative easing, buying newly created money to purchase U.S. Treasuries.

Given the recent weakness in the bond market, it is worth noting that U.S. Treasury Inflation‑Protected Securities (TIPS) are expected to outpace inflation by 2%‑3% per year over the medium to long term.
That stands in stark contrast to the typical work situation. Even amid the so‑called employment boom, wage growth clearly cannot keep up with inflation.

items.title: 美國拉高太陽能進口門檻  全球市場恐分裂成兩套價格
items.title_en: U.S. Raises Solar Import Price Floor, Global Market May Split into Two Price Sets
paras: 2026年09月07日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國將自12月4日起對進口多晶矽及太陽能產品設定最低價格，可能使全球太陽能市場形成兩套價格：美國在貿易壁壘保護下維持高價，原本銷往美國的產品則轉進歐洲、中東及其他亞洲市場，加重美國以外地區的價格競爭。
根據美國第11052號公告，多晶矽最低進口價格為每公斤21美元，矽晶錠及矽晶圓為每公斤100美元，太陽能電池為每瓦0.22美元，太陽能模組則為每瓦0.38美元，12月4日起生效。矽晶錠及指定下游產品另適用15%從價關稅。
最低進口價格不是禁止低價產品進入美國，而是要求進口商補繳價差。若產品申報價格低於門檻，美國海關將課徵差額關稅，使進口成本提高至規定水準。
這項機制等於把美國市場價格與全球行情分開。依目前市場價格，全球多晶矽約每公斤8至12美元，美國設定的最低價格為21美元；全球太陽能模組約每瓦0.10至0.15美元，美國門檻則達0.38美元。
即使全球供過於求、產品價格持續下跌，進口至美國的太陽能產品仍須維持在最低價格以上。美國本土製造商因此不必完全跟隨全球低價競爭，但當地的開發商及安裝商也要承擔更高的電池、模組與建置成本。
美國市場價格提高，不代表全球過剩產能因此消失。中國多晶矽及矽晶圓大量出口至東南亞，在當地製成太陽能電池與模組後，再銷往美國。政策生效後，東南亞產品若失去價格競爭力，原本準備銷往美國的供給就要尋找其他市場。
歐洲、中東、拉丁美洲及其他亞洲國家可能成為主要去向。當更多產品集中進入這些市場，供給增加可能壓低價格，使美國以外地區的太陽能業者面對更激烈競爭。
全球太陽能市場因而可能分成兩個價格區域。美國透過最低進口價格維持較高售價，美國以外市場則繼續反映全球產能過剩。兩地價差不再只來自運費與一般關稅，而是由政策直接拉開。
在供應鏈各環節中，太陽能電池受到的影響可能最明顯。美國本土電池產能不足，對進口依賴度高，每瓦0.22美元的最低價格又明顯高於全球行情。進口電池價格上升後，美國模組廠的成本也會增加，最終可能反映在太陽能電站建置費用。
中國供應鏈受到的影響則以間接為主。中國直接出口美國的多晶矽規模有限，但東南亞工廠若減少對美出貨，可能降低對中國多晶矽及矽晶圓的採購，壓力再沿產業鏈向上游傳導。
政策生效前，約120天的過渡期可能帶動提前拉貨。美國進口商有動機在最低價格上路前增加採購，短期可能增加東南亞電池與模組，以及中國上游材料的需求。但這只是把未來訂單提前，12月後可能轉為庫存消化。
美國也希望透過較高價格吸引製造業回流。企業若承諾在美國新建、翻新或擴建多晶矽、矽晶錠、矽晶圓及太陽能電池設施，並在2029年1月20日前動工，可申請在建廠期間免繳部分232關稅。
不過，美國新產能從建廠到量產需要時間。在本土供給尚未補上之前，進口價格已先提高，可能推升太陽能建置成本並使部分專案延後。若需求因此下降，美國製造商能否靠較高價格擴大銷量，仍有待觀察。
整體來看，美國232措施不是消除全球太陽能產能過剩，而是把過剩供給排除在美國的低價市場之外。結果可能是美國價格維持高檔，其他地區承受更多供給與降價壓力，全球太陽能市場從單一價格競爭走向區域化定價。

paras_en: September 7, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The United States will set minimum import prices for polysilicon and solar products starting December 4, a move that could create two price regimes in the global solar market: a higher price protected by U.S. trade barriers and lower‑priced products originally destined for the U.S. shifting to Europe, the Middle East and other Asian markets, intensifying price competition outside the United States.

According to U.S. Notice No. 11052, the minimum import price for polysilicon is $21 per kilogram, for silicon ingots and wafers $100 per kilogram, for solar cells $0.22 per watt and for solar modules $0.38 per watt, effective December 4. Silicon ingots and designated downstream products are also subject to a 15% ad‑valorem tariff.

The price floor does not ban low‑priced goods from entering the United States; it requires importers to pay the price difference. If a product is declared below the threshold, U.S. Customs will levy a differential duty, raising the import cost to the prescribed level.

The mechanism effectively separates U.S. market prices from global market prices. At current market rates, global polysilicon trades at about $8‑$12 per kilogram, whereas the U.S. floor is $21; global solar modules trade at about $0.10‑$0.15 per watt, while the U.S. floor is $0.38 per watt.

Even if global supply exceeds demand and product prices keep falling, solar products imported into the United States must stay above the minimum price. Domestic manufacturers therefore do not have to compete fully with low global prices, but local developers and installers will bear higher costs for cells, modules and system construction.

Higher U.S. market prices do not eliminate global overcapacity. China’s polysilicon and wafers are shipped in large volumes to Southeast Asia, where they are turned into cells and modules and then exported to the United States. After the policy takes effect, if Southeast Asian products lose price competitiveness, the supply originally earmarked for the U.S. will have to find other markets.

Europe, the Middle East, Latin America and other Asian countries could become the main destinations. As more products flow into these markets, increased supply may push prices down, exposing solar firms outside the United States to fiercer competition.

The global solar market could therefore split into two price zones. The United States maintains higher selling prices through the import floor, while markets outside the United States continue to reflect global overcapacity. The price gap will no longer stem only from freight and ordinary tariffs but will be directly created by policy.

Among the supply‑chain stages, solar cells are likely to feel the most impact. U.S. domestic cell capacity is insufficient and relies heavily on imports; the $0.22 per watt floor is markedly above global levels. Higher imported cell prices will raise costs for U.S. module makers, eventually feeding into higher solar‑farm construction costs.

China’s supply chain is affected mainly indirectly. Direct Chinese exports of polysilicon to the United States are limited, but if Southeast Asian factories cut shipments to the U.S., their purchases of Chinese polysilicon and wafers could fall, transmitting pressure upstream in the industry.

Before the policy takes effect, an approximately 120‑day transition period may trigger early stockpiling. U.S. importers have an incentive to increase purchases before the floor kicks in, potentially boosting short‑term demand for Southeast Asian cells and modules as well as upstream Chinese materials. However, this merely advances future orders, and after December the surge may turn into inventory draw‑down.

The United States also hopes higher prices will attract manufacturing reshoring. Companies that commit to building, renovating or expanding polysilicon, silicon ingot, wafer or solar‑cell facilities in the United States and start construction by January 20, 2029 can apply for partial exemption from Section 232 tariffs during the construction period.

Nevertheless, new U.S. capacity takes time to move from construction to mass production. Until domestic supply catches up, import prices have already risen, potentially lifting solar‑project costs and delaying some projects. If demand falls as a result, it remains to be seen whether U.S. manufacturers can expand sales by relying on higher prices.

Overall, the U.S. Section 232 measure does not eliminate global solar overcapacity; it simply excludes excess low‑price supply from the U.S. market. The likely outcome is a high‑price tier in the United States and greater supply‑and‑price‑cut pressure elsewhere, shifting the global solar market from a single‑price competition to regional pricing.
