items.title: 日元上周大幅震盪 匯市本周如何演繹？
items.title_en: Yen Saw Large Volatility Last Week: How Will the FX Market Play Out This Week?
paras: 上週稍早，美元兌日元匯率一度攀升至160.39，創7月底美日聯合干預以來的最高水準，但上週四(3日)日元突大幅走強，單日漲幅接近2%，創聯合干預以來最大單日升幅。美元兌日元自160.39高點快速回落，最低下探155.3附近，離7月干預後的低點155.23僅一步之遙。日元上周累計升值約2.5%，創7月底來最大單周升幅紀錄。
不同於7月底，此輪日元急升目前並無明確證據顯示東京當局再次入市干預，日本央行(BOJ)相關數據也未顯示波動由官方直接推動，市場更傾向歸因於BOJ升息預期升溫、日元空頭回補，以及聯準會(Fed)升息預期降溫。
日元此輪急升的直接驅動力，來自日美貨幣政策預期的逆向變動。知情人士透露，BOJ傾向本月將基準利率上調25個基點以應對通膨上行風險。
BOJ審議委員高田創上周表示，升息1碼「並非一定板上釘釘」，一般而言連續升息也有可能，總裁植田和男則明言若判斷金融條件過於寬鬆，完全可能加快升息步伐。
隔夜指數掉期數據顯示，市場對BOJ本月升息1碼定價已接近100%，並完全反映明年1月前再次升息，野村證券更指出，在日元持續疲軟的極端情境下，BOJ可能在12月前的3次會議上連續升息。
美國方面，聯準會理事沃勒上週四表示，美國通膨已出現一些降溫跡象，下一次利率決策將「很大程度上」受即將公布的8月通膨數據影響。偏鴿派表態推動市場削減對9月升息的押注，機率已降至約50%。
目前美國政策利率仍處3.5%-3.75%區間，即使BOJ本月升息至1.25%，兩國利差仍有225至250個基點。
不過市場交易的是方向變化，日本緊縮、美國寬鬆的預期逆轉，正動搖套利交易的基礎。
隨著日元逼近155關口，空頭踩踏風險急劇升溫。摩根大通策略師田中俊雅等人警告，若美元兌日元貶破155，龐大的空頭部位恐被逼加速解除，引發連鎖賣盤。
根據摩根大通估計，目前仍有約16-17兆日元的看空部位尚未平倉，若完全解除，理論上可能將匯價推入142至146區間，但其基準判斷仍是美元兌日元處於155至165區間。
另一重大不確定性來自日本官方。最高外匯事務官員三村淳表示，對近期日元走勢「既不滿意，也沒有感到安心」，日本仍處「高度警戒狀態」，被解讀為可能繼續干預的訊號。分析人士認為，9月18日BOJ會議後恰逢「白銀周」假期，流動性下降，不排除當局利用此時段行動。
paras_en: Earlier last week the USD/JPY rate surged to 160.39, the highest level since the joint US‑Japan intervention at the end of July, but on Thursday (the 3rd) the yen rallied sharply, gaining almost 2% in a single day – the biggest one‑day rise since the intervention. The dollar fell back quickly from the 160.39 peak, sliding to around 155.3, just a hair away from the post‑July low of 155.23. The yen appreciated about 2.5% over the week, the largest weekly gain since the end of July.

Unlike the end‑July move, there is no clear evidence that Tokyo authorities have intervened again, and BOJ data do not show the swing being driven directly by officials. The market attributes the rally mainly to hotter expectations of BOJ rate hikes, short‑covering of yen bears, and a cooling of Fed‑hike expectations.

The immediate driver of the yen’s sharp rise is the opposite shift in US‑Japan monetary‑policy expectations. Insiders say the BOJ is inclined to raise its benchmark rate by 25 basis points this month to counter upside inflation risks.

BOJ policy‑board member So Takada said a one‑tick hike “is not set in stone” and that consecutive hikes remain possible, while Governor Kazuo Ueda stated that if financial conditions are judged too loose, the bank could accelerate the pace of tightening.

Overnight index‑swap data show the market is pricing a one‑tick BOJ hike this month at almost 100% and fully factoring in another hike before January 2025. Nomura Securities adds that in an extreme scenario of continued yen weakness, the BOJ could deliver three consecutive hikes across its meetings before December.

In the United States, Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that inflation is showing some cooling signs and that the next rate decision will be “largely” influenced by the upcoming August inflation data. His dovish tone has pushed the market’s probability of a September hike down to roughly 50%.
The U.S. policy rate remains in the 3.5%‑3.75% band, so even if the BOJ lifts its rate to 1.25% this month, the bilateral spread would still sit at about 225‑250 basis points.
However, what the market is trading is the change in direction – the reversal of expectations toward tighter Japan and looser U.S. policy is unsettling the foundation of carry‑trade arbitrage.

As the yen nears the 155 threshold, the risk of a short‑covering squeeze rises sharply. JPMorgan strategists such as Toshimasa Tanaka warn that if USD/JPY falls below 155, massive short positions could be forced to unwind quickly, sparking a cascade of sell orders.

JPMorgan estimates that roughly ¥16‑17 trillion of short yen positions remain open; if they were all liquidated, the rate could theoretically be pushed into the ¥142‑¥146 range, although the firm still views USD/JPY as residing in the ¥155‑¥165 band.

Another major uncertainty comes from Japanese officials. Senior FX official Jun Mimura said he is “neither satisfied nor reassured” by the recent yen moves and that Japan remains in a “high‑alert” state, a comment read as a possible signal of further intervention. Analysts note that the BOJ meeting on September 18 falls during the “Silver Week” holiday, when liquidity thins, and they do not rule out action during that window.

items.title: 伊朗宣布：將在荷姆茲海峽之外設立禁區
items.title_en: Iran Announces: Establishing a No‑Go Zone Outside the Strait of Hormuz
paras: 據伊朗伊斯蘭共和國廣播電視台6日（周日）報導，伊朗最高國家安全委員會秘書穆赫辛·雷扎伊說，將宣布在荷姆茲海峽之外設立一個禁區，進入船隻將受到制裁。
雷扎伊稱，將在未來數日公布這一新設立的禁區，範圍將從美國海軍「封鎖線」延伸至波斯灣部分海域，任何進入這一範圍的船隻都將被伊方列入制裁名單。
雷扎伊表示，美國總統川普稱荷姆茲海峽仍處於開放狀態是「謊言」。美方試圖投入大量資金，以「走私方式」讓船隻通過有關海域，這些船隻通常會遭到伊方打擊。
目前伊朗沒有決定擊沉這些船隻，因為船隻裝載石油，被擊沉可能破壞中東生態。
談及國內物資供應，雷扎伊說，美國經濟封鎖將導致伊朗發生大規模飢荒的說法是「巨大謊言」，伊朗政府已儲備足夠糧食和基本物資。
他同時表示，伊朗仍在出口石油，相關收入也能夠匯回國內。
在軍事方面，雷扎伊稱，伊朗48小時前首次在一艘美國軍艦上空試驗了一種特殊反艦飛彈。他說，伊朗武裝部隊此前打擊了美國在約旦的軍事目標，有關打擊使川普放棄此前宣布的「10日戰爭」計畫。
在談判問題上，雷扎伊表示，美國若希望繼續談判，必須重新贏得伊朗的信任，伊朗只在獲得保障的情況下繼續推進外交努力。
paras_en: According to Iran’s Islamic Republic Broadcasting Corporation on Sunday the 6th, Mohammad Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, said a no‑go zone will be announced outside the Strait of Hormuz and vessels entering it will face sanctions.

Rezaei said the new zone will be disclosed in the coming days, extending from the U.S. Navy’s “blockade line” to parts of the Persian Gulf, and any ship entering that area will be placed on Iran’s sanctions list.

Rezaei stated that U.S. President Trump’s claim that the Strait of Hormuz remains open is a “lie.” He said the United States is trying to pour large amounts of money into “smuggling” vessels through the area, vessels that are usually targeted by Iranian forces.
Iran has not decided to sink those vessels because they are carrying oil and sinking them could damage the Middle‑East’s ecological environment.

Regarding domestic supplies, Rezaei called the claim that U.S. economic sanctions would cause a massive famine in Iran a “huge lie,” noting that the Iranian government has stocked sufficient food and essential goods.
He also said Iran continues to export oil and that the related revenues can be repatriated to the country.

On the military side, Rezaei said Iran, for the first time 48 hours ago, tested a special anti‑ship missile over a U.S. warship. He added that Iranian forces had previously struck a U.S. military target in Jordan, a strike that led President Trump to abandon his previously announced “10‑day war” plan.
Regarding negotiations, Rezaei said that if the United States wants to continue talks it must regain Iran’s trust, and Iran will only move forward diplomatically if it receives guarantees.

items.title: 越南躍居對美順差第一大國 對中逆差卻高達773億美元
items.title_en: Vietnam Leaps to Top Spot as Largest US Trade Surplus Country, Yet Runs $77.3 Billion Deficit with China
paras: 越南2026年上半年對美貿易順差衝上1,140億美元，首度超越中國，成為對美貿易順差最大的國家。不過，越南同期整體貿易逆差卻接近170億美元，創近10年新高，其中對中國貿易逆差達773億美元，凸顯出口榮景背後的結構性矛盾。
越南對美順差躍居第一，關鍵推力來自關稅差距。上半年中國輸美商品面臨約23%的有效關稅率，越南僅約6.5%，相差16.5個百分點，促使企業將產線由中國轉往越南。例如邁阿密家具商TOV Furniture的中國採購比重，已從2024年的60%降至25%，越南則由25%升至60%。
中國資本也是越南出口成長的重要推手。2025年前8個月，中國對越南新批投資達26.5億美元，占新批外資總額24%，僅次於新加坡。跨國企業採取「中國加一」策略，三星在越南設有全球最大的手機生產基地，富士康等企業也陸續跟進。目前外資企業貢獻越南近八成出口額，內資企業僅占兩成。
然而，越南仍較接近「超級組裝車間」，尚未建立完整工業體系。2026年上半年，越南自中國進口1,152億美元，年增36%，占進口總額40.7%；其中電腦、電子產品及零件達397.7億美元，機械設備及配件為219.6億美元。
越南對美出口愈多，對中國零組件與設備的需求也隨之增加，形成「中國供應零件、越南組裝、出口美國」的三角貿易鏈。
越南的關稅優勢也面臨挑戰。美國貿易代表署已於2026年3月啟動對16國的301調查，越南名列其中。第一季越南對美出口年減12.8%，合板、水產及紡織品降幅均超過30%，部分外資產能也轉往泰國及馬來西亞。
對越南而言，真正考驗不在順差能衝多高，而是能否在優勢消退前，從組裝基地升級為製造強國。
paras_en: Vietnam posted a $114 billion trade surplus with the United States in the first half of 2026, overtaking China for the first time to become the biggest surplus holder with the U.S. However, its overall trade balance for the same period showed a near‑$17 billion deficit, the highest in almost a decade, with a $77.3 billion deficit against China, highlighting a structural contradiction behind the export boom.

Vietnam’s surge to the top U.S. surplus spot is driven mainly by tariff differentials. In the first half of the year, Chinese goods bound for the U.S. faced an effective tariff rate of about 23%, while Vietnam’s rate was only around 6.5% – a gap of 16.5 percentage points that has prompted firms to shift production lines from China to Vietnam. For example, Miami‑based furniture company TOV Furniture reduced the share of its Chinese sourcing from 60% in 2024 to 25%, while its Vietnamese sourcing rose from 25% to 60%.

Chinese capital also plays a key role in Vietnam’s export growth. In the first eight months of 2025, new Chinese investment in Vietnam reached $2.65 billion, accounting for 24% of total new foreign investment, second only to Singapore. Multinationals are adopting a “China‑plus‑one” strategy; Samsung operates the world’s largest mobile phone plant in Vietnam, and firms such as Foxconn are following suit. Today, foreign‑owned enterprises contribute nearly 80% of Vietnam’s export value, with domestic firms providing only about 20%.

Nevertheless, Vietnam remains closer to a “super assembly workshop” and has not yet built a complete industrial ecosystem. In the first half of 2026, Vietnam imported $115.2 billion from China, up 36% year‑on‑year and representing 40.7% of total imports; of this, computers, electronic products and components accounted for $39.77 billion and machinery and equipment parts for $21.96 billion.

As Vietnam’s exports to the United States increase, its demand for Chinese components and equipment also rises, creating a triangular trade chain: China supplies parts, Vietnam assembles them, and the finished goods are shipped to the U.S.

Vietnam’s tariff advantage is also facing headwinds. The U.S. Trade Representative launched a Section 301 investigation in March 2026 covering 16 countries, with Vietnam among them. In the first quarter, Vietnam’s exports to the U.S. fell 12.8% year‑over‑year, with plywood, seafood and textiles each dropping by more than 30%, and some foreign‑owned capacity shifting to Thailand and Malaysia.
For Vietnam, the real test is not how high the surplus can climb, but whether it can upgrade from an assembly hub to a manufacturing powerhouse before its comparative advantages fade.

items.title: 伊朗警告美國再攻擊將遭「更猛烈」反擊！制裁加劇經濟壓力、石油出口受阻
items.title_en: Iran Warns the United States of "More Intense" Retaliation if Attacked Again! Sanctions Heighten Economic Pressure, Oil Exports Disrupted
paras: 伊朗表示，面對美國制裁持續衝擊經濟，政府將加大力度處理相關問題；與此同時，伊朗國會議長卡利巴夫（Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf）警告，美國若再度攻擊伊朗利益與安全，將面臨「更迅速、更猛烈且更具破壞性」的反擊。
根據《路透》報導，美以對伊朗發動攻擊至今已約6個月，戰事目前陷入僵局。6月達成的初步停火協議已告破裂，外交斡旋也尚未取得足以讓和平進程重新啟動的進展。
7月大部分時間軍事行動一度暫緩，但近期雙方攻擊再度升溫。美國中央司令部（U.S. Central Command）週六（5日）表示，美軍擊中了3艘伊朗油輪，此舉是對伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊（IRGC）向2艘美國海軍艦艇發射彈道飛彈的回應。
卡利巴夫週日（6日）表示，美國「應該在為時已晚之前」理解，這場與伊朗戰爭的遊戲規則已經改變。他指出，今後任何針對伊朗利益與安全的攻擊，都將遭到更迅速、更猛烈且更具破壞性的回應。
目前伊朗仍具備攻擊鄰近國家美國利益的能力，同時也能以封鎖荷姆茲海峽作為重要籌碼。戰事爆發前，全球約1/5的石油供應會經由這條重要航道運輸。

制裁與石油封鎖　伊朗經濟承受更大壓力

不過，3名伊朗高級官員表示，美國透過封鎖伊朗石油出口及打擊規避制裁行為，試圖進一步壓縮伊朗經濟活動，相關壓力正變得愈來愈難以承受。
卡利巴夫週日指出，除了軍事戰線之外，伊朗目前另一場主要戰鬥是提高生產、維持民眾生計。他將匯率劇烈波動、通膨、失業及市場管理列為政府面臨的主要問題。
他表示，伊朗民眾可以承受困難，但無法接受管理不善或政府無所作為，並要求政府迅速採取行動。
伊朗經濟部長馬達尼扎德（Ali Madanizadeh）則表示，德黑蘭計畫透過改革應對美國經濟壓力，並否認制裁會迫使伊朗改變政策方向。
他指出：「他們（美國）談論經濟施壓與孤立、切斷金融聯繫，並認為透過對一國經濟施壓，就能迫使該國人民改變決定。」
馬達尼扎德強調：「改革伊朗經濟是伊朗政府與人民的責任，而不是美國財政部的責任。」
根據伊朗半官方通訊社塔斯尼姆（Tasnim）報導，伊朗經濟部副部長扎馬尼安（Morteza Zamanian）週日也表示，經濟部的「經濟戰爭總部」正在加倍努力處理戰爭所造成的經濟問題。

伊朗稱哈爾克島遭攻擊約550次　石油出口仍未中斷

伊朗是石油輸出國組織（OPEC）第三大產油國，戰前約90%的原油出口經由哈爾克島（Kharg Island）石油出口樞紐運輸。不過，自美國4月中旬開始封鎖伊朗石油出口後，相關石油運輸已受到干擾。
美國總統川普8月31日曾在社群媒體發布一則簡短訊息，並搭配一段AI生成影片，畫面呈現哈爾克島遭到「炸成碎片」。伊朗當局此前已警告，若哈爾克島遭到攻擊，將採取強力反制。
伊朗石油部長帕克內賈德（Mohsen Paknejad）週日接受國營電視台訪問時表示，哈爾克島在過去數月遭到約550次攻擊，但目前仍持續運作。
另一方面，伊朗封鎖荷姆茲海峽也對全球能源市場造成壓力，推升燃料價格，並可能成為川普在11月美國期中選舉前面臨的政治問題。
paras_en: Iran said that as U.S. sanctions continue to hit its economy, the government will step up efforts to address related issues; at the same time, Iran’s parliament speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf warned that any further U.S. attacks on Iranian interests and security would meet a "faster, more intense and more destructive" response.

According to Reuters, the U.S.-Israel attacks on Iran have been ongoing for about six months and the conflict is now at a stalemate. The preliminary cease‑fire agreement reached in June has collapsed, and diplomatic mediation has yet to produce progress sufficient to restart the peace process.

Most of July saw a lull in military actions, but attacks have recently heated up again. U.S. Central Command said on Saturday the 5th that U.S. forces struck three Iranian oil tankers in response to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps firing ballistic missiles at two U.S. Navy vessels.

Qalibaf said on Sunday the 6th that the United States "should understand before it’s too late" that the rules of the game in the war with Iran have changed. He noted that any future attacks on Iranian interests and security will be met with a faster, more intense and more destructive response.

Iran still retains the capability to strike U.S. interests in neighboring countries and can use a blockade of the Strait of Hormuz as a key bargaining chip. Before the war, about one‑fifth of global oil supplies passed through this vital waterway.

Sanctions and oil blockades – Iran’s economy bears greater pressure. However, three senior Iranian officials said the United States is trying to further squeeze Iran’s economic activity by blocking oil exports and cracking down on sanction‑evasion, and the pressure is becoming increasingly unbearable.

Qalibaf noted that beyond the military front, Iran’s other major battle is to boost production and sustain citizens’ livelihoods. He listed volatile exchange rates, inflation, unemployment and market management as the main problems facing the government.
He said the Iranian people can endure hardship but will not accept mismanagement or governmental inaction, and he called for swift government action.
Economy Minister Ali Madanizadeh said Tehran plans to respond to U.S. economic pressure through reforms and denied that sanctions would force Iran to change its policy direction.

He remarked, "They (the United States) talk about economic pressure, isolation, cutting financial links, and believe that by pressuring a country’s economy they can force its people to change decisions."
Madanizadeh emphasized, "Reforming Iran’s economy is the responsibility of the Iranian government and its people, not the U.S. Treasury."

According to Iran’s semi‑official news agency Tasnim, Deputy Economy Minister Morteza Zamanian said on Sunday that the ministry’s ‘Economic War Headquarters’ is redoubling its efforts to address the economic problems caused by the war.

Iran says Kharg Island has been attacked about 550 times, but oil exports remain uninterrupted. Iran is the OPEC’s third‑largest producer, and before the war roughly 90% of its crude exports were shipped via the Kharg Island hub. However, since the United States began blocking Iranian oil exports in mid‑April, related shipments have been disrupted.

Former President Donald Trump posted a short message on social media on August 31, accompanied by an AI‑generated video showing Kharg Island “blown to pieces.” Iranian authorities had previously warned that a strike on Kharg Island would trigger a strong retaliation.
Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad told state TV on Sunday that Kharg Island has suffered roughly 550 attacks in recent months but continues to operate.

Meanwhile, Iran’s blockade of the Strait of Hormuz is also pressuring global energy markets, pushing fuel prices higher and potentially becoming a political issue for Trump ahead of the U.S. mid‑term elections in November.

items.title: 滙豐范力民：AI成長面臨三大風險、長端美債殖利率難降、中國AI及科技族群對外資極具吸引力
items.title_en: Frederic Neumann of HSBC: AI Growth Faces Three Major Risks, Long‑Term US Treasury Yields Won’t Fall, Chinese AI and Tech Sectors Highly Attractive to Foreign Investors
paras: AI熱潮能否延續？美債殖利率為何持續攀升？外資又如何看待中國資產？滙豐環球投資研究首席亞洲經濟學家兼亞洲聯席主管范力民(Frederic Neumann)近日接受《中國基金報》專訪時逐一給出解答。
范力民指出，本輪全球經濟復甦的一大特徵，是增長高度依賴AI。美國經濟由AI硬體投資驅動，從南韓、台灣、日本到越南、馬來西亞乃至中國，增長亦主要由AI熱潮帶動，AI相關硬體已成近期拉動中國出口的重要力量，但他也是警稱「AI正在創造真實的增長，這當然是好事，但硬幣另一面是全球成長的支撐面正變得愈來愈狹窄。這意味AI投資一旦放緩，衝擊將是全球性、即時的。」
他列舉AI熱潮面臨的三大挑戰：一是融資成本提升，美、日、歐政府債券殖利率上升將推高AI融資成本，侵蝕項目盈利能力與估值；二是能源約束，地緣政治問題疊加聖嬰現象推高能源價格、限制供給；三是社會問題，許多經濟體出現「K型復甦」，AI領域表現優異，但勞動力市場承壓、年輕人就業困難，資料中心建設也因耗費資源、噪音等問題面臨抵制，AI安全風險上升，亟需監測與監管。

范力民認為，中國的結構性特徵使其在本輪AI周期中佔據相對有利位置：一，較早對AI採取審慎規劃與監管路徑，並在能源基礎設施上提前布局，對社會衝擊與能源約束準備更充分；二，技術能力不止於AI，綠色技術已成為中國日益主導的領域，正好對應全球能源短缺下的真實需求缺口，生物技術與製藥進展亦對全球醫療健康體系構成實質貢獻；三，金融體系相對封閉疊加龐大居民儲蓄，令中國得以在全球利率上行周期中維持獨立的低利率環境，這正是高科技企業發展所需。
他同時指出，中國與其他國家一樣呈現「科技高增長、消費及就業疲軟」的K型復甦特徵。綜合判斷，中國經濟今年實現4.5%至5%的區間目標仍有較大把握。
針對美債殖利率走高，范力民歸納三大驅動因素：最重要的是巨額財政赤字，規模龐大且無下降跡象，引發市場對其可持續性的憂慮，該問題幾乎無解；其次是AI長期借貸需求增加，資金自長期債券投資中被抽走；最後才是通膨擔憂，重要性最低，三者共同發力，即便聯準會(Fed)調整利率，長端美債殖利率也不太可能大幅下降。
范力民並提示，儘管有政客認為AI帶來的生產率提升可使GDP增速超過赤字增速，但他認為這不太可能發生，反而會帶來自滿情緒，讓情況變得更糟。
范力民提出三種可能觸發美元走弱的情景：若美國政府人為壓低殖利率曲線以控制利息成本，殖利率將與持有美元的風險不匹配，最終損害美元地位；若AI泡沫破裂，全球資金不再購買美國AI相關資產，美元需求下降；若AI熱潮轉移至亞洲、歐洲等地區，資料中心大規模在海外建設，同樣利空美元。
他認為，上述情景在未來6-9個月內不太可能發生，但放眼2028至2030年，美元可能貶值，歐元、日元及部分亞洲貨幣將受益，人民幣亦可能隨之升值。
但范力民強調，目前美元作為全球主要儲備貨幣的地位仍難以撼動，因為全球範圍內很難找到替代品。
對於去美元化與多元配置，范力民直言非常困難，數據顯示全球資產配置並未出現大規模多元化，原因同樣是投資人難以找到替代選項。
他解釋道，黃金市場規模很小，日元疲弱，歐洲缺乏優質資產，還面臨俄烏戰爭帶來的經濟與地緣政治問題。「我們確實看到部分資金流向中國股票及中國政府債券，但規模仍遠低於美股和美債。儘管近期中國也在加速科技企業IPO，並擴大離岸人民幣債券發行。而且，中國利率很低，說明資金充裕，不需要更多錢。」
范力民觀察到，中國AI及科技族群對外資極具吸引力，但非科技領域仍存觀望情緒，外資正等待中國經濟回暖、消費改善、信貸增長、房市企穩等信號，若這些信號兌現，將有更多資金流入。
至於香港角色轉型，范力民則指出，近年香港角色已從「把全球資本引入中國」轉變為「幫助中國資本走向世界」。具體而言，香港可協助中國企業全球擴張，提供融資、交易設計、對沖安排等服務；同時透過跨境理財通、保險通等機制，幫助中國居民進行全球資產配置。
他認為，在推動人民幣國際化方面，香港具備獨特優勢。作為開放體系，外資可來港便捷融資，並選擇借入價格低廉的離岸人民幣，此舉將直接增加人民幣需求。
paras_en: AI hype—can it continue? Why are US Treasury yields still climbing? How do foreign investors view Chinese assets? Frederic Neumann, chief Asian economist and co‑head of Asia at HSBC Global Investment Research, answered each question in a recent interview with China Fund News.

Neumann notes that a key feature of the current global economic recovery is growth that is heavily dependent on AI. The US economy is being driven by AI hardware investment, and from South Korea, Taiwan, Japan to Vietnam, Malaysia and even China, growth is likewise propelled by the AI boom. AI‑related hardware has become a major driver of recent Chinese exports, but he warns that “AI is creating real growth, which is good, yet the other side of the coin is that the support base for global growth is becoming increasingly narrow. This means that if AI investment slows, the impact will be global and immediate.”

He lists three major challenges facing the AI boom: first, rising financing costs as government bond yields in the US, Japan and Europe increase, eroding project profitability and valuations; second, energy constraints, with geopolitical tensions and the El Niño phenomenon pushing up energy prices and limiting supply; third, social issues, as many economies experience a “K‑shaped recovery” where AI performs well but labour markets are strained, youth unemployment rises, data‑center construction faces resistance over resource use and noise, and AI safety risks grow, requiring monitoring and regulation.

Neumann believes China’s structural characteristics give it a relatively advantageous position in this AI cycle: (1) it adopted a cautious planning and regulatory path for AI early and pre‑emptively built energy infrastructure, making it better prepared for social and energy shocks; (2) its technological capabilities extend beyond AI, with green technologies now a dominant Chinese field that meets real global energy‑shortage demand, while biotech and pharma advances also make substantive contributions to worldwide health systems; (3) a relatively closed financial system combined with massive household savings allows China to maintain an independent low‑rate environment even as global rates rise, which is essential for high‑tech firms.

He also points out that, like other countries, China shows a “K‑shaped recovery” of high tech growth but weak consumption and employment. Overall, he judges that China is still likely to hit its 4.5%‑5% GDP growth target for this year.

Regarding the rise in US Treasury yields, Neumann identifies three drivers: the most important is the huge fiscal deficit, massive and showing no sign of shrinking, which fuels market worries about sustainability and is virtually unsolvable; second is the growing long‑term borrowing demand from AI, pulling funds out of long‑term bond investments; third, and least important, is inflation concern. Together they keep long‑term US yields high even if the Fed adjusts policy rates.

Neumann cautions that, although some politicians claim AI‑driven productivity gains could make GDP grow faster than the deficit, he thinks this is unlikely and could instead breed complacency, worsening the situation.

He outlines three scenarios that could weaken the dollar: if the US government artificially suppresses the yield curve to control interest‑costs, yields would no longer match the risk of holding dollars, ultimately harming the dollar’s status; if the AI bubble bursts, global capital would stop buying US AI‑related assets, reducing dollar demand; and if the AI boom shifts to Asia or Europe, with massive data‑center construction overseas, the dollar would also be hurt.

He believes these scenarios are unlikely in the next 6‑9 months, but looking to 2028‑2030 the dollar could depreciate, benefiting the euro, yen and some Asian currencies, with the renminbi also likely to appreciate.
Nevertheless, Neumann stresses that the dollar’s position as the world’s primary reserve currency remains hard to dislodge because viable global alternatives are scarce.

On de‑dollarisation and diversified allocation, he says it is very difficult; data show global asset allocation has not become broadly diversified, mainly because investors struggle to find substitute options.

He explains that the gold market is small, the yen is weak, Europe lacks quality assets, and the region still faces economic and geopolitical issues from the Russia‑Ukraine war. “We do see some capital flowing into Chinese equities and government bonds, but the scale is still far below that of US stocks and Treasuries. Although China is accelerating tech‑company IPOs and expanding offshore renminbi bond issuance, its low rates indicate ample liquidity, so there is no need for more money.”

Neumann observes that Chinese AI and tech groups are extremely attractive to foreign investors, while non‑tech sectors remain cautious. Foreign capital is waiting for signals of an economic rebound, improved consumption, credit growth, and a stabilising property market; if those materialise, more funds will flow in.

Regarding Hong Kong’s role shift, he notes that in recent years Hong Kong has moved from “bringing global capital into China” to “helping Chinese capital go global.” Specifically, Hong Kong can assist Chinese firms in worldwide expansion, providing financing, transaction structuring and hedging services, and through cross‑border schemes such as Stock Connect and Insurance Connect, help Chinese residents allocate assets globally.

He concludes that Hong Kong has a unique advantage in promoting renminbi internationalisation. As an open system, foreign investors can easily obtain financing in Hong Kong and borrow cheap offshore renminbi, directly boosting demand for the currency.

items.title: AI多頭等待的突破終於來了？高盛：OpenAI Astra模型「脫穎而出」
paras: OpenAI新一代Astra模型橫空出世，市場重新燃起對AI「智慧突破」的期待，高盛更認為，若模型能力持續大幅躍升，AI產業可能迎來新一輪需求擴張，進一步延長資本支出週期；然而，在軟銀、甲骨文(ORCL-US) 等相關個股率先上漲之際，日元升值、能源供應風險與聯準會（Fed）即將公布的CPI數據，仍可能成為這波AI樂觀情緒能否延續的關鍵考驗。
高盛Delta One交易台主管Rich Privorotsky在最新市場簡報中指出，Astra的表現具有重大意義，模型能力明顯領先同業，這類實質性的「智慧突破」正是AI多頭長期等待的訊號。
市場也迅速反映這項消息。OpenAI重要投資者軟銀股價隔夜大漲逾10%，由於軟銀持有OpenAI投資部位，其股價經常被視為OpenAI估值變化的市場映射；甲骨文股價也上漲約5.5%。
不過，Privorotsky認為，相關個股上漲反而不是這次事件最值得關注的部分。真正重要的是，如果AI模型能力持續出現跨越式進展，可能重新擴大企業可開發的應用範圍，進而支撐整體AI支出週期。

模型變便宜與模型變聰明，是兩回事

Privorotsky特別區分AI模型「降價」與「能力提升」對市場需求帶來的不同影響。
如果只是token價格下降，企業主要是以更低成本使用既有的AI能力；但若模型本身出現實質性的智慧躍升，企業將可能開始開發過去因技術限制而無法實現的新應用，AI需求曲線也會因此重新擴張。
他指出，真正的智慧突破不僅會改變需求，也會迫使其他AI實驗室持續追趕，進一步維持整個產業的支出動能，並強化市場對「仍有更好的AI應用值得開發」的預期。
Privorotsky也針對先前「token需求增速可能追不上token成本下降」的觀點進一步說明。他認為，只有在模型能力沒有出現根本性進步的情況下，算力供給過剩才可能成為問題；Astra的出現則顯示，目前市場可能正朝另一個方向發展。

OpenAI喊「代際飛躍」 AI競爭轉向智能能力

Astra在部分與AGI相關的基準測試中展現強勁表現，也讓OpenAI對模型能力給出高度評價。
OpenAI總裁Greg Brockman形容Astra可能成為AGI發展的重要節點。面對Astra是否已符合AGI定義的問題，他則直接表示：「我認為就是這個模型。」
不過，目前業界對AGI仍沒有統一的定義與標準化測試方式，Brockman也指出，最終仍應由使用者來判斷。
分析指出，這也反映AI產業競爭正在發生變化。市場競爭不再只是圍繞模型價格與運算效率，而是逐步轉向模型「智慧」本身的較量。
對AI多頭而言，如果模型領先優勢能持續透過能力提升體現，將有助於重新建立市場對AI資本支出週期延續性的信心。

日元走強 日銀升息預期與財政擴張同時出現

除了AI題材之外，Privorotsky也將焦點放在日元走勢。
近期日元持續走強，但目前尚未看到明顯的市場干預跡象；另一方面，市場對日本央行（BOJ）的政策預期轉向更為鷹派，目前已反映9月升息幅度略高於25個基點，以及未來一年累計升息接近100個基點的預期。
與貨幣政策收緊形成對比的是，日本財政政策仍在擴張。Privorotsky指出，日本2027財年預算申請總額已達143.1兆日元。
財政擴張與貨幣緊縮同時存在，加上日元升值，形成目前日本市場值得關注的政策組合。日元升值可能對出口商造成壓力，但日本銀行股則可能持續受惠，Topix銀行指數已升至今年高點。
此外，日元升值也可能削弱市場上的套息交易，進而對全球風險資產構成壓力。

能源供應風險仍是市場最大變數

相較於AI帶來的樂觀情緒，能源市場仍是Privorotsky認為最需要關注的宏觀風險。
荷姆茲海峽航運目前仍受到嚴重干擾。雖然美國已證明能夠護航大型原油船隊通過海峽，但更廣泛的供應問題仍未獲得解決，成品油與液化天然氣（LNG）運輸依然受到阻礙，庫存也持續承受壓力。
Privorotsky認為，目前的供應狀態難以長期維持，因此能源價格仍可能成為市場風險偏好最大的干擾因素。
他也警告，周末期間中東局勢可能出現新的升級或降溫變化；另一方面，隨著美國國內政治因素的重要性提高，未來也可能出現推動中東局勢緩和的機會。
俄烏局勢近期也出現一些外交層面的正面訊號，但Privorotsky認為，市場目前仍不宜對和平前景抱持過高期待。

聯準會等待CPI AI樂觀情緒面臨宏觀數據考驗

在美國貨幣政策方面，市場正逐步尋找聯準會維持利率不變的可能路徑。此前聯準會官員沃勒（Christopher Waller）的言論也顯示，決策核心目前並未出現明顯政策轉向，後續仍將取決於經濟數據。
因此，市場焦點已逐漸從就業數據轉向下周公布的消費者物價指數（CPI）。
經歷8月市場震盪後，投資人持倉已經有所下降，先前表現不佳的共識交易與動能交易也有所降溫。
Privorotsky認為，只要CPI沒有出現明顯的上行意外，風險資產仍存在進一步走強的空間。在這種情況下，Astra所重新點燃的AI投資敘事，也可能成為市場新的推動力量。
接下來市場將迎來甲骨文財報，以及一系列科技產業會議。投資人將從雲端基礎設施與AI業務等領域尋找更多訊號，觀察模型能力突破能否進一步轉化為產業需求與資本支出。
不過，能源價格仍是市場必須留意的主要風險，德國薩克森－安哈特邦周末舉行的選舉同樣受到關注。

items.title: Anthropic掛牌倒數 多檔槓桿ETF蓄勢待發 連Claude都建議別碰
items.title_en: Anthropic Nears IPO Countdown, Multiple Leveraged ETFs Poised, Even Claude Advises Against It
paras: 人工智慧（AI）新創公司Anthropic可能還要數週才會上市，但基金業者已摩拳擦掌，準備推出個股ETF，讓投資人放大押注這家AI公司的股價表現。
Claude開發商Anthropic已祕密遞交首次公開募股（IPO）申請，預計未來幾週內正式提交公開文件。這意味Anthropic股票最快可能於本月稍晚或10月掛牌交易，屆時投資人將有多檔個股ETF可供選擇，押注這檔AI新股。
不過，策略師甚至AI本身都警告，這類產品波動劇烈，投資人必須具備極高的風險承受能力，並不適合採取長期買進持有策略。
多家基金業者布局槓桿產品
Direxion、Tradr、Leverage Shares及GraniteShares等基金公司，均已公布計畫，準備在Anthropic股票開始交易後不久，推出與其掛鉤的槓桿ETF。REX Shares與Tuttle Capital Management也早在今年3月申請推出純做多的Anthropic ETF。
槓桿型個股ETF透過選擇權、交換合約及期貨等衍生性金融商品，放大所追蹤個股或指數的每日漲跌幅，常見產品為2倍槓桿。
例如，若某檔股票單日上漲2%，其2倍做多ETF理論上應上漲4%；相反地，2倍放空或反向ETF則應下跌4%。若該股票下跌2%，2倍反向ETF理論上則會上漲4%。
這類產品聽起來風險很高，事實也確實如此。當被問及個股ETF整體而言是否安全時，Anthropic旗下Claude給出的回答相當直接。
Claude表示：「簡短答案是：不安全。」它並指出，個別公司的所有特有風險，包括財報不如預期、訴訟及執行長爭議等，都會被槓桿進一步放大。
Claude還表示，由於每日槓桿會產生複利效應，這類產品通常是為短線交易設計，而非供投資人長期買進持有。
每日重設恐使報酬偏離預期
這項提醒完全切中要點。推出相關產品的基金公司均謹慎說明，槓桿ETF會每日重設，因此容易受到短期波動影響。換句話說，當標的股票持續上漲時，做多ETF的長期漲幅可能不如投資人預期；若股價一路走高，反向ETF的跌幅則可能遠超想像。
以GraniteShares 2倍做多輝達(NVDA-US) 每日ETF為例，該基金今年來上漲28.6%，並未達到輝達2026年迄今23.5%漲幅的兩倍。另一方面，GraniteShares 2倍放空輝達每日ETF今年已暴跌近50%。
提出警告的也不只有Claude。市場專家同樣認為，個股ETF並非一般投資人可以輕易承受的產品。
晨星北美ETF與被動式策略研究主管Bryan Armour近期在報告中形容，個股ETF就像金融市場的懸浮滑板，沒有太多實際用途，卻可能隨時起火爆炸。
Armour指出，過去4年個股ETF的報酬率中位數為負38%；自成立以來，有19%的個股ETF虧損超過75%，僅18%的產品表現優於其追蹤的股票。
業者坦言只適合短線交易
基金公司本身也強調，這些產品並非長期投資工具。Direxion執行長Douglas Yones向《巴隆周刊》表示，這類ETF是為交易者設計，並提醒投資人注意槓桿相關風險。
GraniteShares執行長Will Rhind則表示，SpaceX的案例顯示，市場對指標性IPO相關交易工具的需求不僅立即浮現，而且多空雙方都相當旺盛。
Rhind指出，當一家公司以創紀錄的估值掛牌時，許多交易者都希望透過明確工具，表達對其估值是否過高的看法。他預期，Anthropic上市後也會出現同樣強勁的雙向交易需求。
然而，散戶未必會依照產品原先設定的方式操作。
盈透證券首席策略師Steve Sosnick表示，他理解槓桿對積極型交易客戶具有吸引力，但仍不相信這些產品都被投資人嚴格按照原定用途使用。
熱門新股掛牌後ETF迅速跟進
Anthropic相關ETF計畫並不令人意外。今年槓桿ETF人氣大增，交易者紛紛湧入與SanDisk、美光等熱門股票，以及費城半導體(SOX) 掛鉤的基金。
資產管理業者也因此加快推出與新上市公司連結的產品。SpaceX(SPCX-US) 與SK海力士(SKHY-US) 股票在美國掛牌交易後，僅過數天便有多檔相關ETF上市。
不過，想投資Anthropic仍有其他投機程度較低的方式。最直接的選擇，是等待IPO啟動後，設法在掛牌前取得股票配售。券商可能比照SpaceX上市時的做法，保留部分股份供散戶申購；投資人也可以等股票正式掛牌後，直接在次級市場買進。
部分ETF已提前持有Anthropic
對於不願等待的投資人，目前已有部分ETF透過持有私人股權的特殊目的工具，提前取得Anthropic尚未上市股份的曝險。

根據晨星資料，Tema Photonics & Optical ETF、Tema Electrification ETF、Alger Concentrated Equity ETF、Alger AI Enablers & Adopters ETF、Alger 35 ETF、iShares A.I. Innovation and Tech Active ETF、T. Rowe Price Capital Appreciation Equity ETF及T. Rowe Price Technology ETF，均持有Anthropic上市前股份。
IPO本身的風險已經不低，若再疊加槓桿，風險只會進一步放大。希望參與Anthropic成長的投資人，較穩健的做法可能是選擇持有該公司的多元化基金，或待Anthropic掛牌後直接買進普通股。
畢竟，就連Claude似乎也認為，Anthropic個股ETF並不是一個理想選擇。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic may still be weeks away from listing, but fund managers are already gearing up to launch single-stock ETFs that let investors amplify bets on the AI company's stock performance.

Anthropic, the developer of Claude, has quietly filed an IPO application and is expected to submit public documents in the coming weeks. This means Anthropic shares could debut as early as later this month or in October, at which point investors will have several single-stock ETFs to choose from to wager on the new AI stock.

However, strategists and even the AI itself warn that such products are highly volatile, requiring investors to have a very high risk tolerance and are unsuitable for a long‑term buy‑and‑hold approach.
Multiple fund managers line up leveraged products

Direxion, Tradr, Leverage Shares, GraniteShares and others have announced plans to roll out leveraged ETFs linked to Anthropic shortly after its stock begins trading. REX Shares and Tuttle Capital Management also applied in March to launch a pure long Anthropic ETF.
Leveraged single‑stock ETFs use options, swaps and futures to magnify the daily price movement of the underlying stock or index, with the most common offering 2× leverage.

For example, if a stock rises 2% in a day, a 2× long ETF would theoretically rise 4%; conversely, a 2× short or inverse ETF would fall 4%. If the stock falls 2%, a 2× inverse ETF would theoretically rise 4%.
These products sound extremely risky, and they indeed are. When asked whether single‑stock ETFs are safe overall, Anthropic’s Claude gave a very direct answer.
Claude said, "Short answer: not safe." It noted that all company‑specific risks—missed earnings, lawsuits, CEO controversies—are amplified by leverage.
Claude also pointed out that daily leverage creates a compounding effect, making these products generally designed for short‑term trading rather than long‑term holding.
Daily reset can cause returns to diverge from expectations

That reminder hits the nail on the head. Fund firms launching the products caution that leveraged ETFs reset daily, making them vulnerable to short‑term volatility. In other words, when the underlying stock keeps climbing, the long ETF’s cumulative gain may fall short of expectations; if the stock keeps falling, the inverse ETF’s loss can far exceed what investors anticipate.

Take GraniteShares’ 2× long Nvidia (NVDA‑US) daily ETF as an example: it’s up about 28.6% this year, well below twice Nvidia’s roughly 23.5% gain through 2026. By contrast, GraniteShares’ 2× short Nvidia daily ETF has plunged nearly 50% this year.
Claude isn’t the only one issuing warnings. Market experts also agree that single‑stock ETFs are not products the average investor can easily bear.

Morningstar North America’s ETF and passive‑strategy head Bryan Armour recently described single‑stock ETFs as “floating skateboards in the financial market—little practical use but capable of catching fire at any moment.”

Armour noted that over the past four years the median return of single‑stock ETFs has been –38%; since inception, 19% of them have lost more than 75%, and only 18% have outperformed the stocks they track.
Managers admit they’re only suitable for short‑term trading

Fund firms themselves stress that these products are not long‑term investment tools. Direxion CEO Douglas Yones told Barron’s that such ETFs are built for traders and warned investors about leverage‑related risks.
GraniteShares CEO Will Rhind said the SpaceX case shows demand for IPO‑linked trading tools spikes immediately, with strong interest on both the long and short sides.

Rhind added that when a company lists at a record valuation, many traders want a clear instrument to express whether they think the price is too high. He expects the same robust two‑way demand after Anthropic lists.
However, retail investors may not use the products as originally intended.
Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick said he sees leverage appealing to aggressive traders but doubts that investors consistently use these products for their intended purpose.
Hot new‑issue ETFs follow listings quickly

Anthropic‑related ETF plans are unsurprising. Leveraged ETFs have surged in popularity this year, with traders flocking to products tied to hot stocks like SanDisk, Micron and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (SOX).

Asset managers are accelerating the launch of products linked to newly listed companies. After SpaceX (SPCX‑US) and SK Hynix (SKHY‑US) began trading in the U.S., several related ETFs were launched within days.

Nevertheless, there are lower‑speculation ways to invest in Anthropic. The simplest is to wait for the IPO and try to obtain an allocation before the shares hit the market. Brokers may, as with SpaceX, reserve a portion of shares for retail allocation; investors can also buy the stock on the secondary market once it lists.
Some ETFs already hold Anthropic ahead of the IPO
For investors unwilling to wait, certain ETFs have used special purpose vehicles that hold private‑equity stakes to gain exposure to Anthropic before its public debut.

According to Morningstar, the Tema Photonics & Optical ETF, Tema Electrification ETF, Alger Concentrated Equity ETF, Alger AI Enablers & Adopters ETF, Alger 35 ETF, iShares A.I. Innovation and Tech Active ETF, T. Rowe Price Capital Appreciation Equity ETF and T. Rowe Price Technology ETF all own pre‑IPO Anthropic shares.

The IPO itself carries significant risk, and adding leverage only magnifies it. Investors seeking Anthropic’s growth might be better off holding diversified funds that include the company or buying its ordinary shares after the listing.
After all, even Claude seems to think that an Anthropic single‑stock ETF is not an ideal choice.

items.title: 日元上周大幅震盪 匯市本周如何演繹？
items.title_en: Yen Saw Large Volatility Last Week: How Will the FX Market Play Out This Week?
paras: 上週稍早，美元兌日元匯率一度攀升至160.39，創7月底美日聯合干預以來的最高水準，但上週四(3日)日元突大幅走強，單日漲幅接近2%，創聯合干預以來最大單日升幅。美元兌日元自160.39高點快速回落，最低下探155.3附近，離7月干預後的低點155.23僅一步之遙。日元上周累計升值約2.5%，創7月底來最大單周升幅紀錄。
不同於7月底，此輪日元急升目前並無明確證據顯示東京當局再次入市干預，日本央行(BOJ)相關數據也未顯示波動由官方直接推動，市場更傾向歸因於BOJ升息預期升溫、日元空頭回補，以及聯準會(Fed)升息預期降溫。
日元此輪急升的直接驅動力，來自日美貨幣政策預期的逆向變動。知情人士透露，BOJ傾向本月將基準利率上調25個基點以應對通膨上行風險。
BOJ審議委員高田創上周表示，升息1碼「並非一定板上釘釘」，一般而言連續升息也有可能，總裁植田和男則明言若判斷金融條件過於寬鬆，完全可能加快升息步伐。
隔夜指數掉期數據顯示，市場對BOJ本月升息1碼定價已接近100%，並完全反映明年1月前再次升息，野村證券更指出，在日元持續疲軟的極端情境下，BOJ可能在12月前的3次會議上連續升息。
美國方面，聯準會理事沃勒上週四表示，美國通膨已出現一些降溫跡象，下一次利率決策將「很大程度上」受即將公布的8月通膨數據影響。偏鴿派表態推動市場削減對9月升息的押注，機率已降至約50%。
目前美國政策利率仍處3.5%-3.75%區間，即使BOJ本月升息至1.25%，兩國利差仍有225至250個基點。
不過市場交易的是方向變化，日本緊縮、美國寬鬆的預期逆轉，正動搖套利交易的基礎。
隨著日元逼近155關口，空頭踩踏風險急劇升溫。摩根大通策略師田中俊雅等人警告，若美元兌日元貶破155，龐大的空頭部位恐被逼加速解除，引發連鎖賣盤。
根據摩根大通估計，目前仍有約16-17兆日元的看空部位尚未平倉，若完全解除，理論上可能將匯價推入142至146區間，但其基準判斷仍是美元兌日元處於155至165區間。
另一重大不確定性來自日本官方。最高外匯事務官員三村淳表示，對近期日元走勢「既不滿意，也沒有感到安心」，日本仍處「高度警戒狀態」，被解讀為可能繼續干預的訊號。分析人士認為，9月18日BOJ會議後恰逢「白銀周」假期，流動性下降，不排除當局利用此時段行動。
paras_en: Earlier last week the USD/JPY rate surged to 160.39, the highest level since the joint US‑Japan intervention at the end of July, but on Thursday (the 3rd) the yen rallied sharply, gaining almost 2% in a single day – the biggest one‑day rise since the intervention. The dollar fell back quickly from the 160.39 peak, sliding to around 155.3, just a hair away from the post‑July low of 155.23. The yen appreciated about 2.5% over the week, the largest weekly gain since the end of July.

Unlike the end‑July move, there is no clear evidence that Tokyo authorities have intervened again, and BOJ data do not show the swing being driven directly by officials. The market attributes the rally mainly to hotter expectations of BOJ rate hikes, short‑covering of yen bears, and a cooling of Fed‑hike expectations.

The immediate driver of the yen’s sharp rise is the opposite shift in US‑Japan monetary‑policy expectations. Insiders say the BOJ is inclined to raise its benchmark rate by 25 basis points this month to counter upside inflation risks.

BOJ policy‑board member So Takada said a one‑tick hike “is not set in stone” and that consecutive hikes remain possible, while Governor Kazuo Ueda stated that if financial conditions are judged too loose, the bank could accelerate the pace of tightening.

Overnight index‑swap data show the market is pricing a one‑tick BOJ hike this month at almost 100% and fully factoring in another hike before January 2025. Nomura Securities adds that in an extreme scenario of continued yen weakness, the BOJ could deliver three consecutive hikes across its meetings before December.

In the United States, Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that inflation is showing some cooling signs and that the next rate decision will be “largely” influenced by the upcoming August inflation data. His dovish tone has pushed the market’s probability of a September hike down to roughly 50%.
The U.S. policy rate remains in the 3.5%‑3.75% band, so even if the BOJ lifts its rate to 1.25% this month, the bilateral spread would still sit at about 225‑250 basis points.
However, what the market is trading is the change in direction – the reversal of expectations toward tighter Japan and looser U.S. policy is unsettling the foundation of carry‑trade arbitrage.

As the yen nears the 155 threshold, the risk of a short‑covering squeeze rises sharply. JPMorgan strategists such as Toshimasa Tanaka warn that if USD/JPY falls below 155, massive short positions could be forced to unwind quickly, sparking a cascade of sell orders.

JPMorgan estimates that roughly ¥16‑17 trillion of short yen positions remain open; if they were all liquidated, the rate could theoretically be pushed into the ¥142‑¥146 range, although the firm still views USD/JPY as residing in the ¥155‑¥165 band.

Another major uncertainty comes from Japanese officials. Senior FX official Jun Mimura said he is “neither satisfied nor reassured” by the recent yen moves and that Japan remains in a “high‑alert” state, a comment read as a possible signal of further intervention. Analysts note that the BOJ meeting on September 18 falls during the “Silver Week” holiday, when liquidity thins, and they do not rule out action during that window.

items.title: 日元反轉能走多遠？高盛：結構性修復「剛啟動」、美銀預測年底升至149
paras: 日元近期漲勢強勁，短短數個交易日內升值約3%，市場焦點鎖定日本央行（BOJ）升息預期升溫，以及日本政府退休金投資基金（GPIF）可能增加國內資產配置，兩大政策因素正成為推動日元走強的主要動能。
高盛認為，這波日元升勢並非單純受到短期利差交易帶動，而是日本國內政策環境正逐步轉變。隨著市場對日本央行升息的預期升高，加上GPIF潛在的資產重新配置可能帶來持續日元買盤，過去長期壓抑日元的部分結構性因素，正逐漸轉為支撐日元的力量。
高盛因此判斷，日元長期結構性低估的修復行情可能才剛開始。
美國銀行同樣看好日元後市，認為日本央行加快升息、國內資金回流，以及政策面支撐，都可能持續為日元提供動能。若日本央行9月升息並釋放鷹派訊號，美元兌日元年底可能降至149。
不過，摩根大通雖然也看好日元短期表現，卻提醒市場對日本央行升息及GPIF資產重新配置的預期已反映相當程度。一旦實際政策落地程度不如預期，日元可能面臨快速回檔壓力。
因此，日元這波由日本政策轉向帶動的升勢，能否進一步發展成持續性行情。

高盛：日元強勢可能才剛開始　政策轉向成關鍵

高盛指出，目前推動日元走強的兩大主軸，分別是日本央行升息預期升溫，以及市場預期GPIF可能進一步提高國內資產配置。
其中，GPIF可能引發的資金流動尤其受到關注。高盛援引2020年的經驗指出，GPIF當年雖於3月底正式宣布調整外債配置目標，但相關資金流動早在1、2月便已出現，顯示實際資產調整可能早於政策正式公布。
因此，高盛特別關注9月7日公布的8月國際證券交易（ITS）數據，認為其中可能浮現GPIF資金輪動的早期跡象。
高盛表示，過去幾年日元持續疲弱，很大程度受到美國經濟韌性及日美利差擴大影響；如今日本央行政策方向轉變，加上GPIF可能調整國內資產配置，使日元過去面臨的結構性逆風逐漸減弱，甚至可能轉化為支撐日元的力量。

美銀：日銀轉鷹加上政策支撐　日元升勢仍有空間

美國銀行最新政策研判也認為，日元這波漲勢仍可能延續。
隨著日本央行政策立場轉向偏鷹，此前持續壓抑日元的部分因素正在逐步消退。美銀預期，日本央行可能維持每季升息的步調，目前市場已反映政策利率至2027年7月升至2%的預期。
若日本央行9月升息並釋放鷹派訊號，做空日元的交易邏輯可能進一步弱化。
美銀預估，美元兌日元年底將回落至149，並將155視為重要技術關卡。若匯價跌破155，日元買盤可能進一步加速。
此外，日本經濟基本面改善、升息預期升溫，以及日本投資人可能從海外債券轉向日本國債，都可能為日元提供額外支撐。
政策方面，美銀認為，日本政府扭轉日元弱勢的意願正在升高。財務省此前沒有採取激進干預，可能是希望先為日本央行加快升息創造條件。
若升息路徑更加明確、日元卻仍持續走弱，財務省可能透過買進日元進行干預。因此，即使美元受到支撐，美元兌日元的升值空間仍可能受到政策因素限制。

摩根大通：短線看多日元　但政策若不如預期恐快速回檔

相較之下，摩根大通對GPIF資產重新配置的看法更為保守。
8月31日公布的議程顯示，GPIF於8月21日召開管理委員會，這是7年來首次在8月舉行會議；此外，原本在3月得出「無需審查」結論的基本組合驗證工作，也重新進入討論。
摩根大通認為，這顯示GPIF可能正在重新檢視資產配置，不過短期更可能是在現有配置區間內進行調整，而非正式修改基本組合。
若GPIF將國內債券配置從26.91%提高至區間上限31%，理論上相當於約12.3兆日元的日元買盤；若日本股票配置從23.81%提高至31%，則相當於約21.6兆日元，兩者合計約33.8兆日元。
另一方面，摩根大通認為，市場對日本央行升息的預期已經偏高。9月升息幾乎完全反映在市場價格中，1年期1年期交換利率升至約2.13%，隱含的緊縮速度甚至高於摩根大通自身預測。
若市場對升息的預期開始降溫，日元反而可能承受壓力。

摩根大通重拾美元多頭　9月CPI成關鍵

摩根大通對美元中期走勢則持較正面的看法，認為美元相對於利率基差仍被低估約3%至4%，而美國經濟展現的韌性，也尚未充分反映在目前美元匯率中。
美國失業率目前維持在4.1%，低於聯準會（Fed）年底預測的4.3%。摩根大通預期，在聯準會今年僅升息一次的情境下，美國美元收益率仍將高於全球逾50%的貨幣，接近25年來高位；若全年升息達3次，這一比例將提高至約58%。
接下來，美國8月消費者物價指數（CPI）將成為重要觀察指標。CPI將於9月11日公布，隨後9月16日登場聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議，以及9月17日英國央行、9月18日日本央行的政策會議，主要央行政策預期可能在短時間內密集重新定價。
摩根大通指出，聯準會內部對政策方向仍存在明顯分歧，通膨數據將進一步檢驗市場對未來貨幣政策路徑的預期。
對美元而言，後續走勢將取決於美國經濟數據及聯準會政策預期變化。若美國通膨與就業數據持續展現韌性，美元利率優勢可望獲得支撐；反之，若通膨降溫促使市場重新押注寬鬆政策，美元則可能面臨壓力。

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲周線仍跌 就業數據推升Fed升息預期
items.title_en: New York FX: Dollar Rises but Weekly Trend Still Down as Jobs Data Boosts Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 美元周五(4日)上漲，美國8月就業報告遠優於預期，推動交易員提高對聯準會(Fed)本月稍晚升息的預期，但受周四美國公債殖利率下滑及日元大幅升值帶動，美元本周仍收跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報99.18。本周下跌約0.5%。
外匯市場參與者將目光集中在美國非農就業報告。根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)，8月新增就業16.2萬人，幾乎是市場預期5.5萬人的3倍。失業率維持在4.1%不變。
同時，6月與7月的非農就業人數合計較先前公布數字上修5.5萬人。
這份數據公布之際，聯準會正面臨複雜的政策環境，市場也密切關注利率走向。聯準會偏好的通膨指標——個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數——已連續65個月高於2%的長期目標，也因此導致聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)內部對未來貨幣政策走向出現分歧。
就業市場保持韌性，加上通膨持續居高不下，顯示經濟可能面臨過熱及價格壓力。在這種情況下，央行通常會考慮收緊貨幣政策，因此交易員進一步押注聯準會本月稍晚升息。
美國總統川普則大力稱讚這份就業報告，卻反過來要求聯準會降息，並威脅若其他國家持續對美國保持貿易順差，美國將停止與這些國家進行貿易。
根據CME的FedWatch工具，8月就業數據公布後，市場預期FOMC在9月16日升息25個基點的機率，由約52%升至約58%。
美國政府公債拋售也重新升溫，尤其是對即將到來的政策緊縮較為敏感的短天期債券。美國2年期公債殖利率上升4.5個基點至4.379%，10年期公債殖利率則上升1.8個基點至4.780%。
Interactive Brokers資深經濟學家José Torres表示，「今天早上的非農就業數據強勁到讓殖利率飆升，但川普總統隨後救了美國公債。」
他表示，5個月來最強勁的就業增長提高了未來12天內升息的可能性，使對貨幣政策敏感的2年期公債殖利率升至19個月高點。不過，川普在就業數據公布數小時後發表的評論，使美國公債跌幅收斂，帶動各期限公債殖利率逐漸接近持平。
Torres補充，川普的言論雖然威脅聯準會的獨立性，理論上對美元不利，但經濟成長前景改善正在抵銷這項負面影響，因此美元當天仍走升，只是已遠離盤中高點。
日元大漲後回落
本周表現最亮眼貨幣當屬日元，不過日元週五走弱。
日元在前一交易日暴漲1.9%，升至155.30兌1美元的1個月高點，引發市場廣泛猜測日本政府是否出手干預外匯市場。
儘管目前沒有官方確認日本當局進行干預，日元本周仍上漲2.5%，創下7月底以來最強勁單周表現。
日元近期漲勢主要受到市場押注日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)及政策委員會將在9月17日至18日的會議上升息25個基點，並釋放訊號顯示2027年將持續推動貨幣政策正常化。
其他貨幣方面，加幣走弱，美元兌加幣上漲0.3%至1.3830。
加拿大政府稍早公布數據顯示，該國8月就業市場大幅轉弱，就業人數減少4.17萬人。夏季初期的強勁招聘潮已經消退，加上美國新關稅帶來的不確定性升高，企業面臨更大壓力。市場原本預期8月就業人數將增加1.5萬人，而8月的數據也較7月增加7.51萬人的表現出現明顯反轉。
歐元本周上漲0.2%，市場正等待歐洲央行(ECB)9月10日公布利率決策。市場目前一致預期，歐洲央行將升息25個基點。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 4th), as the U.S. August jobs report far exceeded expectations, prompting traders to raise expectations that the Fed will hike rates later this month, but the dollar still ended the week lower after Thursday’s drop in U.S. Treasury yields and a sharp appreciation of the yen.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, was up 0.3% at 99.18, down about 0.5% for the week.

Forex market participants focused on the U.S. non‑farm payroll report. According to the Bureau of Labor Statistics, August added 162,000 jobs, almost three times the market’s forecast of 55,000. The unemployment rate held steady at 4.1%.
At the same time, the combined non‑farm payroll numbers for June and July were revised upward by 55,000 from previously published figures.

The data were released as the Fed faces a complex policy environment, and markets are watching the direction of interest rates closely. The Fed‑preferred inflation gauge – the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index – has been above the 2% long‑term target for 65 consecutive months, creating divisions within the FOMC about future monetary policy.

A resilient labour market together with persistently high inflation suggests the economy may be overheating and facing price pressures. In such a scenario, central banks typically consider tightening policy, so traders further bet that the Fed will raise rates later this month.

U.S. President Donald Trump praised the jobs report but paradoxically called for a Fed rate cut and warned that if other countries continue to run trade surpluses with the United States, America will cease trade with those nations.

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, after the August jobs data were released, the market’s probability that the FOMC will raise rates by 25 basis points on September 16 rose from about 52% to roughly 58%.

U.S. government bond selling also heated up, especially in short‑term securities that are most sensitive to upcoming policy tightening. The 2‑year Treasury yield rose 4.5 basis points to 4.379%, while the 10‑year yield climbed 1.8 basis points to 4.780%.
Senior economist José Torres of Interactive Brokers said, “The strong non‑farm payroll data this morning sent yields soaring, but President Trump then rescued U.S. Treasuries.”

He added that the strongest job growth in five months boosted the odds of a rate hike within the next 12 days, pushing the 2‑year yield to a 19‑month high. However, Trump’s comments a few hours after the data release narrowed the Treasury sell‑off, causing yields across maturities to move back toward flat.

Torres noted that while Trump’s remarks threaten the Fed’s independence and are theoretically bearish for the dollar, improving growth prospects are offsetting that negative impact, so the dollar still rose that day, albeit well below its intraday peak.
Yen spikes then retreats
The best‑performing currency this week was the yen, although it weakened on Friday.
The yen surged 1.9% the previous trading day to a one‑month high of ¥155.30 per dollar, sparking widespread speculation that the Japanese government might intervene in the FX market.
Even without official confirmation of intervention, the yen still rose 2.5% this week, marking its strongest weekly performance since the end of July.

The recent yen rally is mainly driven by market bets that Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda and the policy board will raise rates by 25 basis points at their September 17‑18 meeting and signal that monetary‑policy normalisation will continue through 2027.
Among other currencies, the Canadian dollar weakened, with USD/CAD up 0.3% at 1.3830.

Canada’s government earlier released data showing a sharp slowdown in August’s labour market, with employment falling by 41,700 jobs. The strong hiring surge that characterised early summer has faded, and heightened uncertainty from new U.S. tariffs is adding pressure on firms. The market had expected August employment to rise by 15,000, and the actual figure also reversed the July gain of 75,100 jobs.
The euro rose 0.2% this week as markets await the European Central Bank’s rate decision on September 10. Consensus now points to a 25‑basis‑point hike by the ECB.

items.title_en: TWD: Hot‑money inflow drives a strong 0.125‑point rise to 31.63; weekly chart turns red, halting five‑week gains
paras: 美國聯準會官員放鴿，台北股匯今(4)日連袂展開反攻，在熱錢回流下，新台幣兌美元匯率中止連二貶走勢，終場強升1.25角，收在31.63元，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 25.925 億美元。
本周外資偏向匯出，新台幣匯率先貶後升，累計小貶 0.2 分，周線翻黑，中止連續 5 周的升值走勢。
在美股回神激勵下，台股今天展開反彈，聯發科、國巨*等權值股領軍走強，大盤終場上漲693.47點，收在46551.13點，站回5日線。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為31.72元，最高升抵 31.627 元，終場收在31.63元、強彈1.25角。
近期日圓升值主要受美日官方聯合干預匯市、日本央行升息預期升溫以及套利交易(Carry Trade)大量平倉所致，已從日前的 160 兌 1 美元一路升到 155 價位。
觀察主要亞幣今天表現，根據央行統計，日元強升0.48%，新台幣升值 0.40%，韓元升值 0.33%，星幣升值 0.16%，人民幣升值 0.1%，亞幣整體偏升。
paras_en: U.S. Federal Reserve officials took a dovish stance, and Taipei's stock and foreign‑exchange markets launched a counter‑attack today (4th). With hot‑money inflows, the New Taiwan dollar against the US dollar halted its two‑session depreciation trend, jumping 0.125 NTD to close at 31.63, while total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market reached US$2.5925 billion.

This week foreign investors tended toward net outflows; the TWD first depreciated then appreciated, resulting in a cumulative small depreciation of 0.2 points. The weekly chart turned red, ending a five‑week appreciation streak.

Boosted by a rebound in U.S. equities, the Taiwan stock market rallied today, with heavyweight stocks such as MediaTek and Yageo leading the gains. The index closed up 693.47 points at 46,551.13, back above its 5‑day moving average.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.72 per US$, peaked at 31.627, and closed at 31.63, a strong bounce of 0.125 NTD.

The recent appreciation of the Japanese yen is mainly due to coordinated intervention by U.S. and Japanese authorities, rising expectations of Bank of Japan rate hikes, and massive unwindings of carry‑trade positions, moving from around 160 yen per dollar to about 155 yen.

Looking at the performance of major Asian currencies today, according to central‑bank data, the yen strengthened by 0.48%, the TWD by 0.40%, the won by 0.33%, the Singapore dollar by 0.16%, the renminbi by 0.10%; overall Asian currencies were on the upside.

items.title: 台灣8月外匯存底重返6000億美元關 終結連2減 增額創16個月來最大
items.title_en: Taiwan's August Foreign Exchange Reserves Rebound to $600.19 B, Ending Two‑Month Decline and Marking the Largest Increase in 16 Months
paras: 台灣央行今(6)日公布我國8月底外匯存底，較上月底增加76.33億美元至6019.04億美元，終結連2月下滑，並創去年5月以來最大增額，而外資持有國內股票及債券按當日市價計算，連同其新台幣存款餘額共折計1兆8610億美元，約當外匯存底309%。
央行外匯局局長蔡烱民說明，8月外匯存底增加主因外匯存底投資運用收益、主要貨幣對美元匯率變動，以及央行為維持外匯市場秩序進場調節。
央行統計，多數非美貨幣升值，其中，加幣升值0.91%、歐元升值0.68%、日元升值0.49%、人民幣升值0.35%，而新台幣更強升達2.51%。
蔡烱民進一步指出，8月雖有外資領股利後匯出因素，但整體淨匯入12億美元，使8月底外資持有國內股票及債券按當日市價計算，連同其新台幣存款餘額回升至1兆8610億美元，約當外匯存底309%。
觀察主要國家外匯存底變化，中國為3兆4188億美元，日本1兆896億美元，瑞士為9458億美元，香港4353億美元，南韓為4174億美元，印度為5913億美元。
paras_en: The Central Bank of Taiwan announced today (the 6th) that the country's foreign exchange reserves at the end of August rose by $7.633 billion to $601.904 billion, ending a two‑month drop and representing the biggest monthly increase since May last year. Including foreign investors' holdings of domestic stocks and bonds valued at market prices on the same day, together with their New Taiwan dollar deposits, the total foreign‑owned assets amount to $1.861 trillion, roughly 309% of the foreign exchange reserves.

Central Bank Foreign Exchange Bureau Director Cai Jiong‑min explained that the August rise in reserves was mainly due to earnings from reserve investments, exchange‑rate movements of major currencies against the U.S. dollar, and the central bank’s market‑stabilisation interventions.

The bank’s data show that most non‑U.S. currencies appreciated: the Canadian dollar rose 0.91%, the euro 0.68%, the yen 0.49%, and the Chinese renminbi 0.35%, while the New Taiwan dollar strengthened even more, gaining 2.51%.

Cai added that although August saw some outflows from foreign investors repatriating dividend payments, net inflows were still $1.2 billion, bringing the market‑value of foreign‑held domestic stocks and bonds, together with their New Taiwan dollar deposits, back up to $1.861 trillion – about 309% of the foreign exchange reserves.

Looking at the foreign‑exchange reserve levels of major economies, China holds $3.4188 trillion, Japan $1.0896 trillion, Switzerland $945.8 billion, Hong Kong $435.3 billion, South Korea $417.4 billion, and India $591.3 billion.

items.title: 印尼盾有望連續第五周上漲 寫兩年來最長連漲紀錄
items.title_en: Indonesian Rupiah Poised for Fifth Consecutive Week of Gains, Setting Two-Year Longest Winning Streak
paras: 印尼盾近日表現強勁，預計將迎來連續第五周上漲，創下兩年來最長的周度連漲走勢。
印尼盾兌美元匯率在周五(4日)亞市早盤交易中報 17,628，持續徘徊在 17,650 附近，本周美元兌印尼盾預計下跌 0.4%，有望創下自 5 月 20 日以來的最低收盤價格。
此波強勢上漲主要受到內外部因素的雙重支撐。其中，外部環境改善，市場因聯準會(Fed)官員的鴿派言論，調降了本月的升息預期。美債殖利率的回落與美元的走弱，皆為印尼盾提供了顯著的短期支撐。
內部政策也有助維持穩定，印尼央行承諾維護匯率穩定。新任印尼央行總裁Destry Damayanti釋放了政策延續性的訊號，強調政策以穩定為先，並透過綜合政策助力經濟成長、維持對境外投資人的吸引力。她也提到，目前國內通膨仍處於受控狀態。
然而，市場分析也指出潛在的制約因素。華僑銀行外匯策略師 Christopher Wong 提醒，高油價與持續高企的全球殖利率依舊是潛在風險。此外，聖嬰現象(El Niño)可能干擾食品供應並推高物價，加上市場在下周公布 8 月外匯存底、消費者信心和 7 月零售銷售等數據前持謹慎態度，皆可能使後續漲勢增添變數。
paras_en: The Indonesian rupiah has been performing strongly recently and is expected to record a fifth consecutive week of gains, marking the longest weekly rally in two years.

The rupiah’s exchange rate against the US dollar was reported at 17,628 in early Asian market trading on Friday (the 4th), hovering around the 17,650 level. This week the dollar is projected to fall 0.4% against the rupiah, potentially delivering the lowest closing price since May 20.

The robust rise is driven by a dual boost of external and internal factors. Externally, the environment has improved as Fed officials’ dovish remarks have lowered market expectations for rate hikes this month. Falling US Treasury yields and a weaker dollar have provided significant short‑term support for the rupiah.

Domestically, policy measures are helping maintain stability. The Bank of Indonesia has pledged to keep the exchange rate steady. New governor Destry Damayanti signaled policy continuity, emphasizing stability as the priority and using a comprehensive policy mix to support growth and retain foreign investor appeal. She also noted that domestic inflation remains under control.

However, analysts point to potential headwinds. OCBC’s FX strategist Christopher Wong warned that high oil prices and persistently elevated global yields remain risks. Additionally, the El Niño phenomenon could disrupt food supplies and push prices higher, and market participants are cautious ahead of next week’s releases of August foreign‑exchange reserves, consumer confidence and July retail sales data, which could add uncertainty to further gains.

items.title: 野村：極端情境下 日本最快今年底前連三次升息
items.title_en: Nomura: In Extreme Scenarios the BOJ Could Raise Rates Three Times Before Year‑End
paras: 野村證券預測，若日元持續走弱，在最極端的情境下，日本銀行(BOJ，央行)可能一路到12月的三次會議上都將接連升息。
野村日本外匯策略主管Yujiro Goto表示，日銀9月升息1碼(25個基點)「看起來合理」，「如果日元走弱的動能持續，朝160日元兌1美元方向發展，那麼10月與12月也可能連續升息」。
他的談話凸顯市場對日銀政策預期所出現的戲劇性轉變。直到不久前，日銀仍以審慎步調推動貨幣政策正常化，如今市場卻開始押注可能加快緊縮腳步。
在市場預期日銀將加速升息，並揣測日本政府退休金投資基金(GPIF)可能調整資產配置的情況下，日元兌美元本周已升值逾2%，來到約156。
隔夜指數交換(OIS)市場顯示，交易員已幾乎篤定日銀9月會升息1碼，並押注明年1月前還會再升息一次。
日銀總裁植田和男先前曾暗示，日銀可能在即將召開的會議上採取行動。而央行內部立場數一數二鷹派的委員高田創(Hajime Takata) ，也並未排除一次較大幅度升息，以及連續升息的可能性。
日元周四(3日)成為外匯市場焦點，當天兌美元一度升至155.30，創8月3日以來最高，當時距離美日歷史性聯手干預匯市短短數日。
日元本周稍早一度貶破160整數關卡，也就是被視為東京當局密切關注的關鍵干預水準。雖然周四沒有任何干預行動獲得證實，但投資人間的相關揣測甚囂塵上。
不過，若真的連續三次會議升息，對過去30年大部分時間都在對抗通縮、並將借貸成本維持在接近零水準的日銀而言，將代表極為罕見的快速緊縮步調。
Goto的基本預測情境則沒有如此激進。他預期，日銀未來每季至少升息一次的可能性或必要性很高，目前對日元匯價預測仍維持在154。
Goto表示，日本政府對貨幣政策的態度，可能是決定日元漲勢能否持續的關鍵。投資人正關注日本首相高市早苗是否會釋出支持日本銀行進一步緊縮政策的訊號，因為她過去曾對升息表達保留態度。
Goto說：「如果高市仍對日本銀行升息表達負面態度，市場將感到失望，日元可能再度遭到拋售。」
反之，如果高市早苗避免對貨幣政策表態，或強調日銀的獨立性，Goto認為，日元有機會升破150日元兌1美元。
美國聯準會(Fed)的政策也可能成為另一項催化劑。Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，若接下來公布的數據證實通膨壓力正在降溫，他將傾向在Fed下一次貨幣政策會議上主張維持利率不變。
Goto認為，從近期Fed官員的談話來看，美國可能不急於在9月升息。
交易員目前預期，Fed決策官員9月15-16日開會時升息的機率約為54%，低於華勒發表談話前的約62%。
假如Fed維持利率不變，而日銀釋出鷹派訊號，美元可能重新走弱，日元可能比投資人預期更早升破155。Goto表示，這將進一步支撐日元走強。
paras_en: Nomura Securities forecasts that if the yen continues to weaken, in the most extreme scenario the Bank of Japan (BOJ) could raise rates at all three meetings through December.

Nomura’s head of Japanese FX strategy, Yujiro Goto, said a 25‑basis‑point hike in September "looks reasonable" and that if yen weakness persists toward ¥160 per dollar, hikes in October and December are also possible.

His comments highlight a dramatic shift in market expectations for BOJ policy. Until recently the BOJ was moving cautiously toward monetary‑policy normalisation, but markets are now betting on a faster tightening pace.

With markets expecting the BOJ to accelerate hikes and speculating that the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF) may rebalance its portfolio, the yen has appreciated more than 2% against the dollar this week to around ¥156.
The overnight index swap (OIS) market shows traders are almost certain of a 25‑basis‑point hike in September and are betting on another hike before January next year.

BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda has previously hinted that the central bank may act at the upcoming meeting, and hawkish board member Hajime Takata has not ruled out a larger‑than‑usual hike or consecutive hikes.
The yen was the focus of the FX market on Thursday (the 3rd), briefly reaching ¥155.30 per dollar, the highest since August 3, just days after a historic joint US‑Japan intervention in the market.

Earlier this week the yen slipped past the ¥160 whole‑number barrier, a level the Tokyo authorities closely monitor for possible intervention. No intervention was confirmed on Thursday, but speculation ran rampant among investors.

If the BOJ were to raise rates at three consecutive meetings, it would represent an unusually rapid tightening for a central bank that has spent most of the past 30 years fighting deflation and keeping borrowing costs near zero.

Goto’s baseline scenario is less aggressive. He expects a high likelihood or even necessity that the BOJ will raise rates at least once each quarter, and he still forecasts the yen around ¥154 per dollar.

Goto said the Japanese government’s stance on monetary policy could be decisive for the yen’s upward momentum, and investors are watching whether Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi will signal support for further BOJ tightening, as she has previously expressed reservations about rate hikes.
"If Takaichi continues to voice a negative view on BOJ rate hikes, the market will be disappointed and the yen could be sold off again," Goto said.
Conversely, if Takaichi avoids commenting on policy or stresses the BOJ’s independence, Goto believes the yen could break above ¥150 per dollar.

U.S. Federal Reserve policy could also act as a catalyst. Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that if upcoming data confirm cooling inflation pressures, he would lean toward keeping rates unchanged at the next Fed meeting.
Goto thinks recent Fed officials’ remarks suggest the United States is unlikely to rush a September rate hike.
Traders currently estimate about a 54% chance that the Fed will raise rates at its September 15‑16 meeting, down from roughly 62% before Waller’s comments.

If the Fed holds rates steady while the BOJ signals hawkishness, the dollar could weaken again and the yen might appreciate beyond investors’ expectations, possibly breaking above ¥155, which Goto says would further support yen strength.

items.title: 全球利率預期轉向 亞洲貨幣周五普遍走強
items.title_en: Global rate expectations shift, Asian currencies broadly stronger on Friday
paras: 受到聯準會官員言論影響，全球利率預期有所轉變，帶動亞洲主要貨幣在周五普遍走強。
美國聯邦準備理事會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)表示，若通膨持續放緩，他將支持本月維持利率不變。此番言論降溫了市場對9月升息的預期，使美元面臨壓力，美元指數本周預計下跌0.7%至99.06。市場目前正密切關注即將公佈的美國8月份非農就業報告。
在此背景下，日元表現尤受矚目，有望創下自7月底以來最強勁的單周表現，本周已經升值約2.5%。
雖然美元周五兌日元午盤上漲0.3%至156.36，但日元在盤中一度強彈至155.25，逼近7月美日聯合干預時的155.2水位。市場分析指出，日元這波升值並非源於官方直接干預，而是因為市場預期日本央行(BOJ)可能在9月17至18日的會議上採取更鷹派的立場。日本央行此前已在6月將政策利率提高至1%，市場正定價9月再次升息的極高可能性。
與此同時，其他亞太貨幣也各有波動。人民幣匯率保持平穩，受弱勢美元支撐，投資人正持續評估中國私營部門服務業數據與疲軟的官方經濟背景。紐西蘭元與澳元也跟隨央行與貿易訊號波動，美元兌紐元下跌0.3%至1.70左右(紐元約合0.59美元)，紐西蘭央行此前升息25個基點至2.75%；澳洲第二季經濟成長0.4%，澳元兌美元維持在0.72美元附近。
此外，馬來西亞央行周四宣布將基準利率維持在2.75%，美元兌馬來西亞令吉在決議後微幅上漲0.16%至4.04。韓元兌美元小幅升值0.05%，至1,355.65兌1美元，而印度盧比則延續了本周的升勢。
paras_en: Influenced by comments from Federal Reserve officials, global rate expectations have shifted, driving the main Asian currencies to broadly strengthen on Friday.

Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said that if inflation continues to ease, he would support keeping rates unchanged this month. His remarks cooled expectations of a September rate hike, putting pressure on the dollar, with the dollar index expected to fall 0.7% this week to 99.06. Markets are now closely watching the upcoming U.S. August non‑farm payroll report.
Against this backdrop, the yen is attracting particular attention, poised for its strongest weekly gain since the end of July, having already appreciated about 2.5% this week.

Although the dollar rose 0.3% to 156.36 per yen at midday on Friday, the yen surged intraday to 155.25, nearing the 155.2 level seen during the July US‑Japan joint intervention. Analysts note that this yen rally is not the result of direct official intervention but stems from market expectations that the Bank of Japan may adopt a more hawkish stance at its September 17‑18 meeting. The BOJ had previously lifted its policy rate to 1% in June, and markets are pricing a very high probability of another hike in September.

Meanwhile, other Asia‑Pacific currencies showed varied moves. The renminbi remained stable, supported by a weaker dollar, as investors continue to assess Chinese private‑sector services data and a soft official economic backdrop. The New Zealand dollar and Australian dollar also fluctuated on central‑bank and trade signals, with the dollar down about 0.3% to around 1.70 NZD (≈ 0.59 USD) and the RBNZ having previously raised rates by 25 basis points to 2.75%; Australia’s Q2 growth was 0.4%, keeping the Aussie near 0.72 USD.

In addition, Malaysia’s central bank announced on Thursday that it would keep its benchmark rate at 2.75%, with the dollar edging up 0.16% to 4.04 Malaysian ringgit after the decision. The Korean won modestly appreciated 0.05% to 1,355.65 per dollar, while the Indian rupee continued its upward trend for the week.
